segs.ar: وَاِذَا نُشِرْتُ لِلْحِسَابِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ ذُلَّ مَوْقِفِيْ
segs.en: and on the degradation of my situation when I am resurrected fro the Account before You.

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ مَا خَفِيَ عَلَي الْاٰدَمِيِّيْنَ مِنْ عَمَلِيْ
segs.en: Forgive for me those deeds which have been concealed from other humans,
make permanent for me that through which You have covered my faults,

segs.ar: وَارْحَمْنِيْ صَرِيْعًا عَلَي الْفِرَاشِ تُقَلِّبُنِيْ اَيْدِيْ اَحِبَّتِيْ
segs.en: have mercy on me when I am deceased, on my (death)bed, being turned over by my loved ones,

segs.ar: وَتَفَضَّلْ عَلَيَّ مَمْدُوْدًا عَلَي الْمُغْتَسَلِ يُقَلِّبُنِيْ صَالِحُ جِيْرَتِيْ
segs.en: Show favour to me when I am stretched out on the washing-table, being turned from sided to side by my righteous neighbours,

segs.ar: وَتَحَنَّنَ عَلَيَّ مَحْمُوْلًا قَدْ تَنَاوَلَ الْاَقْرِبَآءُ اَطْرَافَ جَنَازَتِيْ
segs.en: Have compassion towards me when I am being and my relatives are holding the sides of my coffin,

segs.ar: وَجُدْ عَلَيَّ مَنْقُوْلًا قَدْ نَزَلْتُ بِكَ وَحِيْدًا فِيْ حُفْرَتِيْ
segs.en: Be magnanimous towards me when I am transferred, and am left to You, and placed into my grave, alone,

segs.ar: وَارْحَمْ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ الْبَيْتِ الْجَدِيْدِ غُرْبَتِيْ حَتّٰي لَا اَسْتَانِسَ بِغَيْرِكَ
segs.en: have mercy on my estrangement in that new dwelling, so that I will not find comfort with anyone other than You.

segs.ar: يَا سَيِّدِيْ اِنْ وَكَلْتَنِيْ اِلٰي نَفْسِيْ هَلَكْتُ
segs.en: My Master, if you entrust me to myself, I will certainly perish.

segs.ar: سَيِّدِيْ فَبِمَنْ اَسْتَغِيْثُ اِنْ لَمْ تُقِلْنِيْ عَثْرَتِيْ
segs.en: My Master, to whom will I resort if You do not overlook my slips?

segs.ar: فَاِلٰي مَنْ اَفْزَعُ اِنْ فَقَدْتُ عِنَايَتَكَ فِيْ ضَجْعَتِيْ
segs.en: To whom will I run for help if I lose Your care for me during my stay (in the grave)?

segs.ar: وَاِلٰي مَنْ اَلْتَجِيْءُ اِنْ لَمْ تُنَفِّسْ كُرْبَتِيْ
segs.en: With whom will I seek refuge if You do not relieve my grief?

segs.ar: سَيِّدِيْ مَنْ لِيْ وَمَنْ يَرْ حَمُنِيْ اِنْ لَمْ تَرْ حَمْنِيْ
segs.en: My Master, who do I have, And who will have mercy on me if You do not?

segs.ar: وَفَضْلَ مَنْ اُؤَمِّلُ اِنْ عَدِمْتُ فَضْلَكَ يَوْمَ فَاقَتِيْ
segs.en: In whose favour should I hope if You withhold Your favour on my day of need,

segs.ar: وَاِلٰي مَنِ الْفِرَارُ مِنَ الذُّنُوْبِ اِذَا انْقَضٰي اَجَلِيْ
segs.en: To whom will I flee from my sins when my appointed time arrives?
My Master, do not punish while I am imploring you,
My Lord, make my hopes reality,
And give me security from my fear.

segs.ar: فَاِنَّ كَثْرَةَ ذُنُوْبِيْ لَا اَرْجُوْفِيْهَا لَهَآ اِلَّا عَفْوَكَ
segs.en: As for my numerous sins, my only hope in relation to them is Your pardon.
O my Master, I am asking You that which I do not deserve,
While You are the worthiest of being feared and the worthiest of forgiving.

segs.ar: فَاغْفِرْلِيْ وَالْبِسْنِيْ مِنْ نَظَرِكَ ثَوْبًا يُغَطِّيْ عَلَيَّ التَّبِعَاتِ
segs.en: So, forgive me and dress me, out of Your attention, a garment covering all my defects,
and forgive them for me so that I will not be held responsible for them.
Verily, You are the Lord of eternal favours,
great pardon,
And generous forgiveness..

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ اَنْتَ الَّذِيْ تَفِيْضُ سَيْبَكَ عَلٰي مَنْ لَا يَسْئَلُكَ
segs.en: My Lord, You are the one whose flowing graces reach those who never ask You
and those who stubbornly deny Your Lordship.

segs.ar: فَكَيْفَ سَيِّدِيْ بِمَنْ سَئَلَكَ وَاَيْقَنَ اَنَّ الْخَلْقَ لَكَ وَالْاَمْرَ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: So, my Master, what should You do to those who ask You and have certainty that all of creation and its affairs belong to You.
Blessed and Exalted are You, O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: سَيِّدِيْ عَبْدُكَ بِبَابِكَ اَقَامَتْهُ الْخَصَاصَةُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
segs.en: My master, (this is) Your servant, at Your door; his neediness has made him stand before you,

segs.ar: يَقْرَعُ بَابَ اِحْسَانِكَ بِدُعَآئِهٖ فَلَا تُعْرِضْ بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ عَنِّيْ
segs.en: am knocking on the door of Your Grace with his prayer So, do not turn Your Generous Face away from me.

segs.ar: وَاَقْبَلْ مِنِّيْ مَا اَقُوْلُ فَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ بِهٰذَا الدُّعَآئِ
segs.en: Accept that which I say, for I have asked through this prayer,

segs.ar: وَاَنَا اَرْجُوْ اَنْ لَا تَرُدَّنِيْ مَعْرِفَةً مِّنِّيْ بِرَافَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: hoping that You will not reject me, because of the knowledge I have of Your compassion and mercy,

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ اَنْتَ الَّذِيْ لَا يُحْفِيْكَ سَآئِلٌ
segs.en: O my Allah, it is You Whom is never disturbed by any suppliant
and Whose kingdom is never decreased owing to donations.

segs.ar: اَنْتَ كَمَا تَقُوْلُ وَفَوْقَ مَا نَقُوْلُ
segs.en: You are as You say and above what we say,
O Allah, I ask You for beautiful patience,
immediate relief,
truthful speech,
and great reward.

segs.ar: اَسْئَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهٖ
segs.en: I ask You, O Lord, for all of goodness,
That which I know of and that which I do not know.

segs.ar: اَسْئَلُكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَئَلَكَ مِنْهُ عِبَادُكَ الصّٰالِحُوْنَ
segs.en: I ask You, O Lord, the best of that which Your righteous servants have asked from You,
O the Best of those asked,
And the Most Benevolent in Giving.
Grant my request in relation to myself, my family,
my parents, my children,
my comrades, and my brothers in You.
Bless my living,
manifest my integrity,
set aright all my affairs,
and include me with those whom You decide to grant long life,

segs.ar: وَحَسَّنْتَ عَمَلَهٗ وَاَتْمَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَرَضِيْتَ عَنْهُ
segs.en: And whose deeds You have made righteous, and whom You have perfected Your favours; those with whom You are pleased,

segs.ar: وَاَحْيَيْتَهٗ حَيٰوةً طَيِّبَةً فِيْ اَدْوَمِ السُّرُوْرِ
segs.en: and whom You have made to live a good life, in permanent happiness,
The most reputable honour, and perfect livelihood.
Surely, You do whatever You will,
And none besides You can do whatever they will.
O Allah, give me the exclusive blessing of Your Remembrance,

segs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ شَيْئًا مِّمَّا اَتَقَرَّبُ بِهٖ فِيْ اٰنَآءِ اللَّيْلِ وَاَطْرَافِ النَّهَارِ رِيَآءً وَلَا سُمْعَةً وَلَا اَشَرًا وَلَا بَطَرًا
segs.en: do not make any of the things by which I seek Your nearness - in the hours of the night and the ends of the days - Showing off or seeking reputation, Nor pretension or insolence.
Include me among those who are in awe of You,
O Allah, grant me sufficient sustenance,
And security in my homeland,

segs.ar: وَقُرَّةَ الْعَيْنَ فِي الْاَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ وَالْوَلَدِ
segs.en: And delight in my family, property, and children,
permanence of Your graces upon me,

segs.ar: وَالصِّحَّةَ فِي الْجِسْمِ وَالْقُوَّةَ فِي الْبَدَنِ
segs.en: A healthy body, A strong physique,
and sound faith.
Employ in Your obedience and the obedience of Your Messenger

segs.ar: مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ اَبَدًا مَّا اسْتَعْمَرْتَنِيْ
segs.en: Muhammad—Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household—as long as You give me life.

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ اَوْ فَرِ عِبَادِكَ عِنْدَكَ نَصِيْبًا
segs.en: Make me one of the most rewarded of Your slaves,

segs.ar: فِيْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ اَنْزَلْتَهٗ وَتُنْزِلُهٗ فِيْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
segs.en: in each and every item of goodness that You have made to descended and You will make to descend during the month of Ramazan, And during Laylatul Qadr (Night of Destiny)

segs.ar: وَمَا اَنْتَ مُنْزِلُهٗ فِيْ كُلِّ سَنَةٍ مِّنْ رَحْمَةٍ تَنْشُرُهَا
segs.en: as well as all that which Youmake to descend every year, of Mercy that You spread out,
good health with which You adorn,
misfortune that You repel,
good deeds that You accept,
and mistakes that You excuse.

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِيْ حَجَّ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ فِيْ عَامِنَا هٰذَا وَفِيْ كُلِّ عَامٍ
segs.en: Bless me with the opportunity to perform Hajj (pilgrimage) to Your Sanctified House, in this year and in every year,

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِيْ رِزْقًا وَاسْعًا مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْوَاسِعِ
segs.en: grant me prosperous sustenance out of Your expansive grace,
And repel, my Master, all evils from me,

segs.ar: وَاقْضِ عَنِّيِ الدَّيْنَ وَالظُّلاَمَاتِ حَتّٰي لَا اَتَاَذّٰي بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْهُ
segs.en: settle my debts and the wrongs I owe (to others), so that I am not harmed by any of them,

segs.ar: وَخُذْعَنِّيْ بِاَسْمَاعِ اَضْدَادِيْ وَاَبْصَارِ اَعْدَآئِيْ وَحُسَّادِيْ وَالْبَاغِيْنَ عَلَيَّ
segs.en: And protect me from the hearing and sight of my enemies, those who envy me, and those who intend to oppress me,
And give me victory over them,
Give me delight and make my heart joyous,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ مِنْ هَمِّيْ وَكَرْبِيْ فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا
segs.en: grant me a way out and a relief from my concerns and griefs,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ مَنْ اَرَادَنِيْ بِسُوْءٍ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيَّ
segs.en: make all those who intend evil towards me, among all Your creatures, to be under my feet,
protect me against the evil of Satan,
the evil of the ruling authority,
and my evil deeds,
purify me from all sins,
save me from Hellfire by Your pardon,
allow me to enter Paradise by Your Mercy,
marry me to the Houril ‘Een by Your Grace,
and join me to Your righteous servants, Muhammad and his progeny,
The pious, good, pure and righteous

segs.ar: صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلٰي اَجْسَادِهِمْ وَاَرْوَاحِهِمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ
segs.en: May Your Mercy and blessings be upon their bodies and souls.
My Lord and My Master, I swear by Your Might and Your Glory,
if You take me to account by my sins, I will ask You by Your pardon.
If You take me to account for my vileness, I will ask You by Your Generosity,

segs.ar: وَلَئِنْ اَدْخَلْتَنِيْ النَّارَ لَاُخْبِرَنَّ اَهْلَ النَّارِ بِحُبِّيْ لَكَ
segs.en: If You make me to enter the Hell-Fire, I will inform the inhabitants of Hell of my love for You.

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ وَسَيِّدِيْ اِنْ كُنْتَ لَا تَغْفِرُ اِلَّا لِاَوْلِيَائِكَ وَاَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
segs.en: My Lord and my Master, if you forgive only Your intimate servants and those who obey You,
to whom then will the sinful resort?

segs.ar: وَاِنْ كُنْتَ لَا تُكْرِمُ اِلَّا اَهْلَ الْوَفَآءِ بِكَ
segs.en: If You honour none but those who loyal to You,
then whose shelter will the evildoers seek?

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ اِنْ اَدْخَلْتَنِي النَّارَ فَفِيْ ذٰلِكَ سُرُوْرُ عَدُوِّكَ
segs.en: My Lord, If You make me to enter the Hell-Fire, in this is the happiness of Your enemy,

segs.ar: وَاِنْ اَدْخَلْتَنِي الْجَنَّةَ فَفِي ذٰلِكَ سُرُوْرُ نَبِيِّكَ
segs.en: And if You admit me to paradise, in this is the happiness of Your Prophet,

segs.ar: وَاَنَا وَاللهِ اَعْلَمُ اَنَّ سُرُوْرَ نَبِيِّكَ اَحَبُّ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ سُرُوْرِ عَدُوِّكَ
segs.en: And I take an oath by Allah, that I know that the happiness of Your Prophet is more beloved to You than the happiness of Your enemy,

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تَمْلَاءَ قَلْبِيْ حُبًّا لَكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You to fill my heart with love for You,
And awe of You,
( My Lord, I ask You to fill my heart) with belief in Your Book,
Faith in You,
Dread from You,
and eager love towards You.

segs.ar: يَا ذَالْجَلاَلِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ حَبِّبْ اِلَيَّ لِقَآئَكَ
segs.en: O Lord of Glory and Honour, make the meeting with You beloved to me,
And (please do) love meeting with me,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْ لِقَائِكَ الرَّاحَةَ وَالْفَرَجَ وَالْكَرَامَةَ
segs.en: and make for me, in meeting You, comfort, relief and honour,
O Allah, join me with the righteous people of the past,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ صَالِح مَنْۢ بَقِيَ وَخُذْبِيْ سَبِيْلَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
segs.en: And make me among the righteous of those to come, and set me on the path of the righteous,

segs.ar: وَاَعِنِّيْ عَلٰي نَفْسِيْ بِمَا تُعِيْنُ بِهِ الصَّالِحِيْنَ عَلٰي اَنْفُسِهِمْ
segs.en: help me against myself with that which You helped the righteous against themselves,
seal my deed with the best of it,
And make my reward for it Paradise, by Your Mercy,
help me manage the good things that You have bestowed upon me,

segs.ar: وَثَبِّتْنِيْ يَا رَبِّ وَلَا تَرُدَّنِيْ فِيْ سُوْءٍ اسْتَنْفَذْتَنِيْ مِنْهُ
segs.en: keep me firm, O Lord, and do not make me turn back to an evil from which you have saved me,
O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْئَلُكَ اِيْمَانًا لَا اَجَلَ لَهٗ دُوْنَ لِقَآئِكَ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You for a faith that will last until I meet You,
Keep me on this faith for as long as You give me life,
Make me die on this faith, when you collect my soul,
And resurrect me on this faith when You raise me up,

segs.ar: وَاَبْرِءْ قَلْبِيْ مِنَ الرِّيَآءِ وَالشَّكِّ وَالسُّمْعَةِ فِيْ دِيْنِكَ
segs.en: Purify my heart from showing off, doubt and pretence in matters of Your religion,
Such that my deeds are sincerely for You.
O Allah, grant me insight in matters of Your religion,
understanding of Your decisions,
and deep understanding of Your knowledge,
And two folds of Your Mercy
(My Lord, grant me) special piety that will bar me from acts of disobedience to You,
And make my face bright with Your Light,
make me desire for that which is with You,

segs.ar: وَتَوَفَّنِيْ فِيْ سَبِيْلِكَ وَعَلٰي مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِكَ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ
segs.en: And make me to die in Your path and on the tradition of Your Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْفَشَلِ
segs.en: O Allah, I seek Your protection against laziness, failure,
grief, cowardice, stinginess,
obliviousness, harshness, destitution,
Poverty, neediness,

segs.ar: وَكُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ وَالْفَوَاحِشِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
segs.en: and all misfortunes and shameful deeds, those of them which are apparent and those which are hidden.
(My Lord, I also) seek Your protection against a self that is never content,
A stomach that is not satiated,
A heart that is not in awe
Prayers that are not heard,
And deeds which bring no benefit.

segs.ar: وَاَعُوْذُبِكَ يَا رَبِّ عَلٰي نَفْسِيْ وَدِيْنِيْ وَمَالِيْ
segs.en: I ask refuge with You, O Lord, when it comes to my self, my religion, my wealth,

segs.ar: وَعَلٰي جَمِيْعِ مَا رَزَقْتَنِيْ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
segs.en: and all that which You have granted me against the accursed Satan.
Surely, You are the Hearing, the Knowing,

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُجِيْرُنِيْ مِنْكَ اَحَدٌ
segs.en: O Allah, none can saveme from You,
and I can never find any shelter against You.

segs.ar: فَلَا تَجْعَلْ نَفْسِيْ فِيْ شَيْءٍ مِّنْ عَذَابِكَ
segs.en: So do not admit me into any of Your punishment,
And do not reject and me and cause me to perish,
And do not reject me with painful torture.
O Allah, accept from me,
Elevate my remembrance,
And my rank,
Offload my burden from me,
Do not take remember me by my mistakes,

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ ثَوَابَ مَجْلِسِيْ وَثَوَابَ مَنْطِقِيْ وَثَوَابَ دُعَآئِيْ رِضَاكَ وَالْجَنَّةَ
segs.en: And make the reward of my sitting, my utterance, and my supplication be Your pleasure and Paradise.

segs.ar: وَاَعْطِنِيْ يَا رَبِّ جَمِيْعَ مَا سَاَلْتُكَ وَزِدْنِيْ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segs.en: Give me, O Lord, all that which I have asked for from You and grant me more favour,

segs.ar: اِنِّيْ اِلَيْكَ رَاغِبٌ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
segs.en: for I seek none but You, O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ اَنْزَلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ اَنْ نَعْفُوَ عَمَّنْ ظَلَمَنَا
segs.en: O Allah, You have ordered us in Your book that we should overlook those who wrong us.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ ظَلَمْنَا اَنْفُسَنَا فَاعْفُ عَنَّا فَاِنَّكَ اَوْلٰي بِذٰلِكَ مِنَّا
segs.en: We have thus wronged ourselves; so, forgive us, for You are worthier of forgiveness than we are.

segs.ar: وَاَمَرْتَنَا اَنْ لَا نَرُدَّ سَآئِلًا عَنْ اَبْوَابِنَا
segs.en: You have ordered us not to reject any beggar being on our doors.

segs.ar: وَقَدْ جِئْتُكَ سَآئِلًا فَلَا تَرُدَّنِيْ اِلَّا بِقَضَآءِ حَاجَتِيْ
segs.en: Here I am begging You; so, do not reject me; rather, respond to my need.

segs.ar: وَاَمَرْتَنَا بِالْاِحْسَانِ اِلٰي مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُنَا
segs.en: You have ordered us to act nicely to those under our authorities.

segs.ar: وَنَحْنُ اَرِقَّائُكَ فَاَعْتِقْ رِقَابِنَا مِنَ النَّارِ
segs.en: We are surely under Your authority; so, release us from Hellfire.
O my Shelter whenever I am aggrieved!
O my Aid whenever hardships hit me!
To You have I resorted.
With You have I sought refuge and haven.
To none save You shall I ever resort.
From none save You shall I ever seek for relief.
So, (please do) aid me and relieve my hardship.

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ الْيَسِيْرَ وَيَعْفُوْ عَنِ الْكَثِيْرِ
segs.en: O He Who accepts the little (deed) and overlooks the much (wrong)!

segs.ar: اِقْبَلْ مِنِّيْ الْيَسِيْرَ وَاعْفُ عَنِّيْ الْكَثِيْرَ
segs.en: Accept my little (deed) and overlook my much (wrong).
You are certainly the All-merciful, the All-forgiving.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْئَلُكَ اِيْمَانًا تُبَاشِرُبِهٖ قَلْبِيْ
segs.en: O Allah, I pray You for faith that covers my heart

segs.ar: وَيَقِيْنًا صَادِقًا حَتّٰي اَعْلَمُ اَنَّهٗ لَنْ يُصِيْبَنٖي اِلَّا مَا كَتَبْتَ لِيْ
segs.en: and true certainty, so that I know that nothing will befall me except what You have written for me.

segs.ar: وَرَضِّنِي مِنَ الْعَيْشِ بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِيْ
segs.en: Make me be satisfied with my livelihood that You have decided for me.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

A_AA12.merits: In Misbah al-Mutahajjid, it has been narrated on the authority of Abu-Hamzah al-Sumali that Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-’Abidin (a.s.) used to offer prayers at the nights of Ramazan wholly. At the last hour of Ramazan nights, he used to say this supplicatory prayer:
A_AA12.meritsUr: مصباح المتہجد میں ابو حمزہ ثمالی سے روایت ہے کہ امام علی بن الحسین زین العابدین علیہ السلام ماہ رمضان کی راتیں پوری کی پوری نماز میں گزارتے تھے۔ اور رمضان کی راتوں کے آخری حصے میں یہ دعا پڑھا کرتے تھے:

segs.en: O my means in troubles!
O my Companion in hardships!
O the Provider of my amenities!
O the utmost of my desires!
It is You Who conceals my defects,
relieves my apprehensions,
and overlooks my slips.
So, (please do) forgive my sin.
O Allah, I pray You for the submission of faith
before I encounter the submission of humiliation in Hellfire.

segs.ar: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
segs.en: O One!: O Absolute! O Besought of all!
segs.tr: ya wahidu ya ahadu ya samadu

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
segs.en: O He Who neither begets nor is He begotten,
segs.tr: ya man lam yalid wa lam yulad

segs.en: and there is none like to Him
segs.tr: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun

segs.en: O He Who confers upon one who beseeches Him
on account of His sympathy and mercy,
and initially grants welfare to those who have not asked for it,
segs.tr: wa yabtadi'u bilkhayri man lam yas'alhu

segs.en: on account of His liberality and generosity!
I beseech You in the name of Your endless generosity
to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and bestow upon me with mercy—vast and comprehensive—
segs.tr: wa hab li rahmatan wasi`atan jami`atan

segs.en: by which I can win the welfare of this world as well as the Next World.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ عُدْتُ فِيهِ
segs.en: O Allah, I implore for Your forgiveness of the sins from which I had repented to You but I committed them again.
segs.tr: allahumma inni astaghfiruka lima tubtu ilayka minhu thumm `udtu fihi

segs.ar: وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِكُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَرَدْتُ بِهِ وَجْهَكَ
segs.en: I implore for Your forgiveness of my righteous acts that although I intended them purely for Your sake,
segs.tr: wa astaghfiruka likulli khayrin aradtu bihi wajhaka

segs.en: some purposes that are not intended for You intruded upon them.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

segs.en: and pardon my transgression and my offenses,
in the name of Your forbearance and magnanimity. O All-generous!
O He Whose beseecher will never be disappointed!
O He Whose His rewards will never run out!

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ عَلاَ فَلاَ شَيْءَ فَوْقَهُ
segs.en: O He Who is so Elevated that nothing can ever be higher than He is
and Who is so Nigh that nothing can ever be closer that He is!
(Please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and have mercy upon me,
O He Who split asunder the sea for (Prophet) Moses,
this very night, this very night, this very night,
this very hour, this very hour, this very hour.
O Allah, (please do) purify my heart from hypocrisy,
my acts from showing off,
my tongue from telling untruths,
and my eye from treason.

segs.ar: فَإِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ ٱلأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ
segs.en: You verily know the stealthy looks and that which the breasts conceal.
segs.tr: fa'innaka ta`lamu kha'inata al-a`yuni wa ma tukhfi alssuduru

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّ هٰذَا مَقَامُ ٱلْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
segs.en: O my Lord, this is the manner of him who seeks Your protection from Hellfire.
segs.tr: ya rabbi hadha maqamu al`a'idhi bika min alnnari

segs.ar: هٰذَا مَقَامُ ٱلْمُسْتَجِيرِ بِكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
segs.en: This is the manner of him who seeks Your shelter against Hellfire.
segs.tr: hadha maqamu almustajiri bika min alnnari

segs.ar: هٰذَا مَقَامُ ٱلْمُسْتَغِيثِ بِكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
segs.en: This is the manner of him who seeks Your aid against Hellfire.
segs.tr: hadha maqamu almustaghithi bika min alnnari

segs.ar: هٰذَا مَقَامُ ٱلْهَارِبِ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
segs.en: This is the manner of him who flees to You from Hellfire.
segs.tr: hadha maqamu alharibi ilayka min alnnari

segs.ar: هٰذَا مَقَامُ مَنْ يَبُوءُ لَكَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ
segs.en: This is the manner of him who returns to You carrying his offenses,
segs.tr: hadha maqamu man yabu'u laka bikhati'atihi

segs.en: confessing of his sins,
and repenting to You—his Lord.
This is the manner of the miserable and poor.
This is the manner of the fearful and seeker of Your refuge.
This is the manner of the aggrieved and distressed.
This is the manner of the depressing and gloomy.
This is the manner of the stranger and drowned.
This is the manner of the alienated and frightened.

segs.ar: هٰذَا مَقَامُ مَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لِذَنْبِهِ غَافِراً غَيْرَكَ
segs.en: This is the manner of him who cannot find anyone save You to forgive his sins,
segs.tr: hadha maqamu man la yajidu lidhanbihi ghafiran ghayraka

segs.en: who cannot find anyone save You to give him power,
segs.tr: wa la lida`fihi muqawiyyan illa anta

segs.en: and who cannot find anyone save You to relieve his grief.
O Allah! O All-generous!

segs.ar: لاَ تُحْرِقْ وَجْهِي بِٱلنَّارِ بَعْدَ سُجُودِي لَكَ وَتَعْفِيرِي
segs.en: (please) do not burn my face with Hellfire after I have prostrated myself before You and I have soiled my face for You.
segs.tr: la tuhriq wajhi bilnnari ba`da sujudi laka wa ta`firi

segs.en: (I did so) without claiming any favor on my part to You;

segs.ar: بَلْ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ وَٱلْمَنُّ وَٱلتَّفَضُّلُ عَلَيَّ
segs.en: rather, it is on account of Your praiseworthy favor to and guidance of me.

segs.ar: إِرْحَمْ أَيْ رَبِّ أَيْ رَبِّ أَيْ رَبِّ
segs.en: So, have mercy, O Lord! O Lord! O Lord…
segs.tr: irham ay rabbi ay rabbi ay rabbi…

segs.en: upon my weakness,
upon my confusedness,
upon the softness of my skin,
upon the separation of my organs,
upon the dispersal of my flesh, body, and corpse,
segs.tr: wa tanathura lahmi wa jismi wa jasadi

segs.en: upon my loneliness and lonesomeness in my grave,
segs.tr: wa wahdati wa wahshati fi qabri

segs.en: and upon my anxiety at the least misfortune that inflicts me.

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ قُرَّةَ ٱلْعَيْنِ وَٱلاِغْتِبَاطَ
segs.en: I beseech You, O Lord, for delight and happiness
segs.tr: as'aluka ya rabbi qurrata al`ayni walightibata

segs.en: on the Day of regret and remorse.

segs.ar: بَيِّضْ وَجْهِي يَا رَبِّ يَوْمَ تَسْوَدُّ ٱلْوُجُوهُ
segs.en: (Please do) whiten my face, O Lord, when some faces will be blackened.
segs.tr: bayyid wajhi ya rabbi yawma taswaddu alwujuhu

segs.en: (Please do) secure me against the Gravest Horror.

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ ٱلْقُلُوبُ وَٱلأَبْصَارُ
segs.en: I beseech You for good tidings when hearts and sights shall be turned about
segs.tr: as'aluka albushra yawma tuqallabu alqulubu wal-absaru

segs.en: and for good tidings when I depart this life.

segs.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَرْجُوهُ عَوْناً لِي فِي حَيَاتِي
segs.en: All praise be to Allah Whom I hope for supporting me in my life
segs.tr: alhamdu lillahi alladhi arjuhu `awnan li fi hayati

segs.en: and Whom I want to act as my Provision on the day of my neediness.

segs.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَدْعُوهُ وَلاَ أَدْعُو غَيْرَهُ
segs.en: All praise be to Allah Whom alone do I beseech and I never beseech anyone rather than Him;
segs.tr: alhamdu lillahi alladhi ad`uhu wa la ad`u ghayrahu

segs.en: and even if I beseech anyone else, he will definitely let me down.
segs.tr: wa law da`awtu ghayrahu lakhayyaba du`a'i

segs.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي أَرْجُوهُ وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَهُ
segs.en: All praise be to Allah for Whom I hope and I never hope for anyone rather than Him;
segs.tr: alhamdu lillahi alladhi arjuhu wa la arju ghayrahu

segs.en: and even if I hope for anyone else, he will definitely disappoint me.
segs.tr: wa law rajawtu ghayrahu la-akhlafa raja'i

segs.en: All praise be to Allah, the All-benefactor, the All-donor,
the All-favorer, the All-liberal,
the Lord of Majesty and Honor,
the Source of all bounties,
the Cause of all good deeds,
the Ultimate Goal of all desires,
and the Answerer of all needs.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

segs.en: and grant me conviction and having good idea about You,
segs.tr: warzuqni alyaqina wa husna alzzanni bika

segs.en: fix my hope for You in my heart,
and deprive me of putting my hope in anyone other than You,

segs.ar: حَتَّىٰ لاَ أَرْجُوَ غَيْرَكَ وَلاَ أَثِقَ إِلاَّ بِكَ
segs.en: so that I shall hope for none but You and I shall trust none but You.
segs.tr: hatta la arjwa ghayraka wa la athiqa illa bika

segs.en: O He Who is Benignant to whom He pleases!

segs.ar: أُلْطُفْ لِي فِي جَمِيعِ أَحْوَالِي بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَىٰ
segs.en: (Please do) have benignity to me in all my manners in the very way that You like and please.
segs.tr: ultuf li fi jami`i ahwali bima tuhibbu wa tarda

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّ إِنِّي ضَعِيفٌ عَلَىٰ ٱلنَّارِ فَلاَ تُعَذِّبْنِي بِٱلنَّارِ
segs.en: O my Lord, I am too weak to encounter Your Fire; therefore, (please) do not punish me with Your Fire.
segs.tr: ya rabbi inni da`ifun `ala alnnari fala tu`adhdhibni bilnnari

segs.en: O my Lord, (please do) have mercy upon my prayers, my earnest imploring,
segs.tr: ya rabbi irham du`a'i wa tadarru`i

segs.en: my fear, my humiliation, my neediness,
segs.tr: wa khawfi wa dhulli wa maskanati

segs.en: my seeking Your protection, and my seeking Your refuge.

segs.ar: يَا رَبِّ إِنِّي ضَعِيفٌ عَنْ طَلَبِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
segs.en: O my Lord, I am too weak to seek earnings in this world
segs.tr: ya rabbi inni da`ifun `an talabi alddunya

segs.en: and You are Ample-giving and All-generous.

segs.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ بِقُوَّتِكَ عَلَىٰ ذٰلِكَ
segs.en: I beseech You, O my Lord, in the name of Your power over that,
Your supremacy over that,
Your dispensing with that,
and my urgent need for that
to grant me sustenance in this year,
in this month,
on this day,
at this hour—

segs.ar: رِزْقاً تُغْنِينِي بِهِ عَنْ تَكَلُّفِ مَا فِي أَيْدِي ٱلنَّاسِ
segs.en: sustenance by which You may make me dispense with what the others possess,
segs.tr: rizqan tughnini bihi `an takallufi ma fi aydi alnnasi

segs.en: from Your sustenance, legal and nice.
O my Lord, from You do I ask,
for You do I desire,
and for You do I hope;
and You are the worthiest of being hoped.
I hope for none but You
and I trust in none but You.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O my Lord, I have wronged myself;
so, (please do) forgive me, have mercy upon me, and grant me good health.
O Hearer of all sounds!
O Gatherer of all that has passed away!
O Reviver of all souls after death!
segs.tr: wa ya bari'a alnnufusi ba`da almawti

segs.en: O He Whom is not screened by murk!
O He Whom is not made confused by sounds!
O He Whom is not engaged by something against another thing!

segs.ar: أَعْطِ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَفْضَلَ مَا سَأَلَكَ
segs.en: (Please do) grant Muhammad—peace be upon him and his Household—the best of all that for which he has besought You,
segs.tr: a`ti muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi afdala ma sa'alaka

segs.en: the best of all that which has been asked from You for him,

segs.ar: وَأَفْضَلَ مَا أَنْتَ مَسْؤُولٌ لَهُ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
segs.en: and the best all that which You shall be asked for him up to the Resurrection Day;
segs.tr: wa afdala ma anta mas'ulun lahu ila yawmi alqiyamati

segs.ar: وَهَبْ لِيَ ٱلْعَافِيَةَ حَتَّىٰ تُهَنِّئَنِي ٱلْمَعِيشَةَ
segs.en: and grant me good health so that I may enjoy my life,
segs.tr: wa hab liya al`afiyata hatta tuhanni'ani alma`ishata

segs.ar: وَٱخْتِمْ لِي بِخَيْرٍ حَتَّىٰ لاَ تَضُرَّنِي ٱلذُّنُوبُ
segs.en: an end up my life with a happy end so that my sins may not injure me.
segs.tr: wakhtim li bikhayrin hatta la tadurrani aldhdhunubu

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ رَضِّنِي بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي حَتَّىٰ لاَ أَسْأَلَ أَحَداً شَيْئاً
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) make me satisfied with that which You have decided for me so that I will not ask anyone else for anything.
segs.tr: allahumma raddini bima qasamta li hatta la as'ala ahadan shay'an

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

segs.en: open to me the stores of Your mercy,

segs.ar: وَٱرْحَمْنِي رَحْمَةً لاَ تُعَذِّبُنِي بَعْدَهَا أَبَداً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segs.en: cover me with mercy from You owing to which You will not punish me neither in this world nor in the Hereafter,
segs.tr: warhamni rahmatan la tu`adhdhibuni ba`daha abadan fi alddunya wal-akhirati

segs.ar: وَٱرْزُقْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ ٱلْوَاسِعِ رِزْقاً حَلاَلاً طَيِّباً
segs.en: grant me legal and pleasant sustenance from Your limitless favor
segs.tr: warzuqni min fadlika alwasi`i rizqan halalan tayyiban

segs.ar: لاَ تُفْقِرُنِي إِلَىٰ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَهُ سِوَاكَ
segs.en: owing to which You will make me dispense with anyone other than You;
segs.tr: la tufqiruni ila ahadin ba`dahu siwaka

segs.en: increasing my gratitude to You
and my neediness and submission before You,
and increasing my dispensing with and doing without everyone save You.
segs.tr: wa bika `amman siwaka ghinan wa ta`affufan

segs.en: O All-benefactor! O All-donor!
O All-favorer! O All-liberal!
O All-omnipotent! O All-sovereign!
(Please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and relieve me from all grievances,
decide the most excellent for me,
bless all my affairs,
segs.tr: wa barik li fi jami`i umuri

segs.en: and settle all my needs.

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لِي مَا أَخَافُ تَعْسِيرَهُ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) make easy for me all that which I anticipate to be difficult,
segs.tr: allahumma yassir li ma akhafu ta`sirahu

segs.ar: فَإِنَّ تَيْسِيرَ مَا أَخَافُ تَعْسِيرَهُ عَلَيْكَ سَهْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
segs.en: for it is quite easy for You to make easy for me that which I anticipate to be difficult.
segs.tr: fa'inna taysira ma akhafu ta`sirahu `alayka sahlun yasirun

segs.en: (Please do) facilitate for me that I anticipate to be complicated,
segs.tr: wa sahhil li ma akhafu huzunatahu

segs.en: give vent to that which I anticipate to be narrow,
save me from that which I anticipate to cause me distress,
and guard me from that which I anticipate to cause me misfortune.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O Allah, (please do) fill in my heart with love for You,
fear from You,
belief in You,
faith in You,
dread from You,
and eagerness to You.
O Lord of Majesty and Honor!

segs.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ لَكَ حُقُوقاً فَتَصَدَّقْ بِهَا عَلَيَّ
segs.en: O Allah, I owe You some rights; so, (please do) consider them alms and excuse me from their liabilities.
segs.tr: allahumma inna laka huquqan fatasaddaq biha `alayya

segs.en: I also owe people some responsibilities; so, (please do) release me from their charges.
You have instructed us to honor our guests,
segs.tr: wa qad awjabta likulli dayfin qiran

segs.ar: وَأَنَا ضَيْفُكَ فَٱجْعَلْ قِرَايَ ٱللَّيْلَةَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ
segs.en: and I am Your guest at this night; so, (please do) decide Paradise for me as honor at this night.
segs.tr: wa ana dayfuka faj`al qiraya allaylata aljannata

segs.en: O Grantor of Paradise!
O Grantor of forgiveness!

segs.ar: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ
segs.en: There is no power nor might save with You.
segs.tr: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bika

segs.note: It is recommended to say this supplicatory prayer, considered the shortest supplicatory prayer to be said at the time of Sahar (pre-dawn). It is also mentioned in Iqbal al-A'mal.
segs.ur: مستحب ہے کہ یہ دعا پڑھی جائے جو سحر (صبح سے پہلے) کے وقت پڑھی جانے والی سب سے مختصر دعا شمار ہوتی ہے۔ یہ اقبال الاعمال میں بھی مذکور ہے۔

segs.ar: يَامَفْزَعِيْ عِنْدَ كُرْبَتِي وَيَاغَوْثِيْ عِنْدَ شِدَّتِي
segs.en: O my Safe haven at grievances! O my Aide at hardships!
segs.tr: YAA MAFZA-E'E I'NDA KURBATEE WA YAA GHAWTHEE I'NDA SHIDDATEE

segs.ar: إِلَيْكَ فَزِعْتُ وَبِكَ اسْتَغَثْتُ وَبِكَ لُذْتُ
segs.en: To You do I turn, Your help do I seek, and with You do I take refuge.
segs.tr: ILAYKA FAZIA'-TU WA BIKASTAGHATH-TU WA BIKA LUD'TU

segs.ar: لَا اَلُوْذُ بِسِوَاكَ وَلَا اَطْلُبُ الْفَرَجَ إِلاَّ مِنْكَ
segs.en: I seek refuge with none save You and I beseech none for relief save You.
segs.tr: LAA ALOOD'U BI-SIWAAKA WA LAA AT'LUBUL FARAJA ILLAA MINKA

segs.en: So, please come to my help and free me from cares.

segs.ar: يَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ الْيَسِيْرَ وَيَعْفُوْ عَنِ الْكَثِيْرِ
segs.en: O He Who accepts even the least effort, and overlooks even great wrongdoing!
segs.tr: YAA MAN YAQBALUL YASEER WA YA'-FOO A'NIL KATHEER

segs.ar: اِقْبَلْ مِنِّي الْيَسِيْرَ وَاعْفُ عَنِّي الْكَثِيْرَ
segs.en: Accept my little effort and overlook my much wrongdoing.
segs.tr: IQBAL MINNIL YASEERA WA A'-FU A'NNIL KATHEER

segs.en: Verily, You are the Oft-Forgiving, the Merciful.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي اَسْاَلُكَ إِيْمَانًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهِ قَلْبِي وَيَقِيْنًا
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You for faith with which You fill my heart, and for certitude,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALUKA EEMAANAN TUBAASHIRU BIHEE QALBEE WA YAQEENAN

segs.ar: حَتَّى اَعْلَمَ اَنَّهُ لَنْ يُصِيْبَنِي إِلَّا مَاكَتَبْتَ لِيْ
segs.en: so that I may know that nothing will afflict me except what You have ordained for me.
segs.tr: HATTAA A'-LAMA ANNAHU LAN YUSEEBANEE ILLAA MAA KATABTA LEE

segs.ar: وَرَضِّنِيْ مِنَ العَيْشِ بِمَا قَسَمْتَ لِي
segs.en: And make me content with the living You have apportioned for me,
segs.tr: WA RAZZINEE MINAL A'YSHI BIMAA QASAMTA LEE

segs.en: O most Merciful of the merciful!

segs.ar: يَاعُدَّتِيْ فِي كُرْبَتِي وَيَاصَاحِبِي فِي شِدَّتِي
segs.en: O my resource in my grief, and my companion in my hardship,
segs.tr: YAA U'DDATEE FEE KURBATEE WA YAA SAAHIBEE FEE SHIDDATEE

segs.ar: وَيَاوَلِيّٖ فِي نِعْمَتِي وَيَاغَايَتِي فِي رَغْبَتِي
segs.en: and my guardian in my blessing, and my ultimate goal in my desire,
segs.tr: WA YAA WALIYYEE FEE NI'-MATEE WA YAA GHAAYATEE FEE RAGHBATEE

segs.ar: اَنْتَ السَّاتِرُ عَوْرَتِيْ وَالْاٰمِنُ رَوْعَتِيْ وَالْمُقِيْلُ عَثْرَتِيْ
segs.en: You are the Concealer of my defects, the Securer of my fright, and the Overlooker of my slips,
segs.tr: ANTAS SAATIRU A'WRATEE WAL AAMINU ROO-A'TEE WAL MUQEELU A'THRATEE

segs.en: so forgive my sin, O most Merciful of the merciful!
segs.tr: FAGHFIR LEE KHATEE-ATEE YAA ARHAMAR RAAHIMEEN

A_AA15.name: Aamal & Duas to be Recited Every Night of Ramazan

segs.note: Imam al-Sadiq (a) is reported to have instructed saying the following supplicatory prayer every night in Ramadan:
segs.ur: روایت ہے کہ امام صادق (ع) نے ماہ رمضان کی ہر رات یہ دعا پڑھنے کی ہدایت فرمائی:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تَجْعَلَ فِيْمَا تَقْضِيْ وَتُقَدِّرُ مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْمَحْتُوْمِ فِى الْاَمْرِ الْحَكِيْمِ مِنَ الْقَضَآءِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُرَدُّ وَلَا يُبَدَّلُ
segs.en: O Allah, I ask You that, among what You decree and ordain from the decisive matter, in the wise command, from the destiny that is not reversed nor changed,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS-ALUKA AN TAJ-A'LA FEEMAA TAQDEE WA TUQADDIRU MINAL AMRIL MAHTOOMI FIL AMRIL HAKEEMI MINAL QADAAA-IL LAZEE LAA YURADDU WA LAA YUBADDAL

segs.ar: اَنْ تَكْتُبَنِيْ مِنْ حُجَّاجِ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ الْمَبْرُوْرِ حَجُّهُمُ الْمَشْكُوْرِ سَعْيُهُمُ الْمَغْفُوْرِ ذُنُوْبُهُمْ الْمُكَفَّرِ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ
segs.en: You inscribe me among the pilgrims of Your Sacred House — whose pilgrimage is accepted, whose effort is thanked, whose sins are forgiven, and whose bad deeds are absolved,
segs.tr: AN TAKTUBANEE MIN HUJJAAJI BAYTIKAL HARAAMIL MABROORI HAJJUHUMUL MASHKOORI SA-I'YUHUMUL MAGHFOORI ZUNOOBUHUMUL MUKAFFARI A'N SAYYI-AATIHIM

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ فِيْمَا تَقْضِيْ وَتُقَدِّرُ اَنْ تُطِيْلَ عُمْرِيْ فِيْ خَيْرٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَتُوَسِّعَ فِيْ رِزْقِيْ
segs.en: and that You decree, among what You ordain, to prolong my life in goodness and well-being, and to expand my sustenance,
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ-A'LA FEEMAA TAQDEE WA TUQADDIRU AN TUTEELA U'MREE FEE KHAYRIN WA A'AAFIYATIN WA TUWASSI-A' FEE RIZQEE

segs.ar: وَتَجْعَلَنِيْ مِمَّنْ تَنْتَصِرُ بِهِ لِدِيْنِكَ وَلَا تَسْتَبْدِلْ بِيْ غَيْرِيْ
segs.en: and to make me one through whom You grant victory to Your religion, and not replace me with another.
segs.tr: WA TAJ-A'LANEE MIMMAN TANTASIRU BIHI LI-DEENIKA WA LAA TASTABDIL BEE GHAYREE

segs.note: According to Anis al-Salihin, it is recommended to say the following every night in Ramadan:
segs.ur: انیس الصالحین کے مطابق، ماہ رمضان کی ہر رات میں یہ کہنا مستحب ہے:

segs.ar: اَعُوْذُ بِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ اَنْ يَنْقَضِيَ عَنِّىْ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ
segs.en: I seek refuge in the majesty of Your generous Countenance from the month of Ramadan passing over me,
segs.tr: A'OOZU BI-JALAALI WAJHIKAL KAREEMI AY YANQADIYA A'NNEE SHAHRU RAMADAAN

segs.ar: اَوْ يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ مِنْ لَيْلَتِيْ هٰذِهِ وَلَكَ قِبَلِيْ تَبِعَةٌ اَوْ ذَنْبٌ تُعَذِّبُنِيْ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: or the dawn breaking upon this night of mine while any liability or sin remains against me for which You would punish me.
segs.tr: AW YATLU-A'L FAJRU MIN LAYLATEE HAAZIHI WA LAKA QIBALEE TABI-A'TUN AW ZAMBUN TU-A'ZZIBUNEE A'LAYH

segs.note: In the margin of al-Balad al-Amin, al-Kaf'ami reports on the authority of Sayyid Ibn Baqi that it is recommended to offer a two-unit prayer every night in Ramadan, reciting in the first unit Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Ikhlas three times, and likewise in the second unit. After finishing, it is recommended to say:
segs.ur: البلد الامین کے حاشیے میں کفعمی سید ابن باقی کے حوالے سے نقل کرتے ہیں کہ ماہ رمضان کی ہر رات دو رکعت نماز پڑھنا مستحب ہے، پہلی رکعت میں سورہ فاتحہ ایک مرتبہ اور سورہ اخلاص 3 مرتبہ پڑھی جائے، اور اسی طرح دوسری رکعت میں بھی۔ ختم کرنے کے بعد یہ کہنا مستحب ہے:

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ حَفِيْظٌ لَا يَغْفُلُ
segs.en: Glory be to Him who is Watchful and never heedless,
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN HUWA HAFEEZUL LAA YAGHFUL

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ رَحِيْمٌ لَا يَعْجَلُ
segs.en: Glory be to Him who is Merciful and never hasty,
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN HUWA RAHEEMUL LAA YA'JAL

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ لَا يَسْهُوْ
segs.en: Glory be to Him who is Ever-standing and never forgetful,
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN HUWA QAAA-IMUL LAA YASHU

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ دَآئِمٌ لَا يَلْهُوْ
segs.en: Glory be to Him who is Everlasting and never distracted.
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAN HUWA DAAA-IMUL LAA YALHU

segs.note: Then it is recommended to say the Four Statements of Glorification (al-Tasbihat al-Arba'ah):
segs.ur: پھر تسبیحاتِ اربعہ کہنا مستحب ہے:

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ اَكْبَرُ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAL LAAHI WAL HAMDU LILLAAHI WA LAA ILAAHA ILLAL LAAHU WALLAAHO AKBAR

segs.note: Then it is recommended to implore forgiveness by saying:
segs.ur: پھر یہ کہہ کر مغفرت طلب کرنا مستحب ہے:

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَكَ سُبْحَانَكَ سُبْحَانَكَ يَا عَظِيْمُ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذَّنْبَ الْعَظيمَ
segs.en: Glory be to You, glory be to You, glory be to You; O Most Great, forgive me the great sin.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAKA SUBHAANAKA SUBHAANAKA YAA A'ZEEMUGH FIR LIYAZ ZAMBAL A'ZEEM

segs.note: Then it is recommended to invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household ten times:
segs.ur: پھر نبی (ص) اور ان کی آل پر دس مرتبہ درود بھیجنا مستحب ہے:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى اٰلِهِ
segs.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household.
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA A'LAA AALIH

segs.note: Whoever offers this prayer in this form will have seventy thousand sins forgiven by Almighty Allah.
segs.ur: جو شخص یہ نماز اس طریقے سے پڑھے گا اللہ تعالیٰ اس کے ستر ہزار گناہ معاف فرمائے گا۔

segs.note: According to a hadith, whoever recites Surah al-Fath in an obligatory prayer will be kept safe throughout that year.
segs.ur: ایک حدیث کے مطابق، جو شخص فرض نماز میں سورہ فتح پڑھے گا وہ اس پورے سال محفوظ رہے گا۔

A_AA16.name: Aamal of Sahar in the Holy Month of Ramazan

segs.note: It is highly advisably not to neglect having the early dawn (fajr) meal (suhur) even if a single date or a drink of water are had.
segs.ur: بہت مستحب ہے کہ سحری ترک نہ کریں، چاہے ایک کھجور یا پانی کا ایک گھونٹ ہی کیوں نہ ہو۔

segs.note: The best food in the early dawn (fajr) meal is fine flour and dates.
segs.ur: سحری (فجر سے پہلے) کے کھانے میں بہترین غذا باریک آٹا اور کھجوریں ہیں۔

segs.note: Recite Surah al-Qadr at sahar, the early dawn.
segs.ur: سورہ قدر سحر کے وقت، یعنی پو پھٹنے سے پہلے پڑھیں۔

A_AA16.merits:
Suhur: A Hadith reads that Almighty Allah and His angels bless those who implore for His forgiveness at the last hours of night and have the early dawn (fajr) meal.”

Surah al-Qadr: A Hadith reads that any believer who recites Surah al-Qadr at the early dawn (fajr) meal and the breaking the fast meal (iftar) will be decided as sacrificing his blood for the sake of Almighty Allah between these two times.
A_AA16.meritsUr:
سحری: حدیث میں ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ اور اس کے فرشتے ان لوگوں پر درود بھیجتے ہیں جو رات کے آخری حصے میں اس سے مغفرت طلب کرتے ہیں اور سحری کھاتے ہیں۔

سورہ قدر: حدیث میں ہے کہ جو مومن سحری اور افطار کے وقت سورہ قدر پڑھے، وہ ان دونوں وقتوں کے درمیان ایسا شمار ہوگا جیسے راہ خدا میں اپنے خون میں نہایا ہو۔

A_AA17.name: Tasbeehat at the Time of Sahar

segs.ar: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يَعْلَمُ جَوَارِحَ الْقُلُوْبِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يُحْصِي عَدَدَ الذُّنُوْبِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يَخْفٰى عَلَيْهِ خَافِيَةٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِيْنَ سُبْحَانَ الرَّبِّ الوَدُوْدِ سُبْحَانَ الفَرْدِ الْوِتْرِ سُبْحَانَ العَظِيْمِ الْاَعْظَمِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَايَعْتَدِيْ عَلٰى اَهْلِ مَمْلَكَتِهِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَا يُؤَاخِذُ اَهْلَ الْاَرْضِ بِاَلْوَانِ الْعَذَابِ سُبْحَانَ الْحَنَّانِ الْمَنَّانِ سُبْحَانَ الرَّؤُوْفِ الرَّحِيْمِ سُبْحَانَ الْجَبَّارِ الجَوَادِ سُبْحَانَ الْكَرِيْمِ الْحَلِيْمِ سُبْحَانَ البَصِيْرِ الْعَلِيْمِ سُبْحَانَ البَصِيْرِ الْوَاسِعِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَلٰى اِقْبَالِ النَّهَارِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَلٰى اِدْبَارِ النَّهَارِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَلٰى اِدْبَارِ اللَّيْلِ وَاِقْبَالِ النَّهَارِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَالْمَجْدُ وَالْعَظَمَةُ وَالْكِبْرِيَآءُ مَعَ كُلِّ نَفَسٍ وَكُلِّ طَرْفَةِ عَيْنٍ وَكُلِّ لَمْحَةٍ سَبَقَ فِي عِلْمِهِ سُبْحَانَكَ مِلْءَ مَا اَحْصٰى كِتَابُكَ سُبْحَانَكَ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ سُبْحَانَكَ سُبْحَانَكَ سُبْحَانَكَ۔
segs.en: Glory be to Him Who is aware of what hearts and minds strive to obtain! Glory be to Him Who knows the exact count of sins! Glory be to Him from Whose view nothing in the heavens and the earths is concealed! Glory be to the Loving Lord! Glory be to the Unique and Single! Glory be to the Great and Greatest! Glory be to Him Who does not transgress against the inhabitants of His kingdom! Glory be to Him Who does not bring down any kind of punishment upon the inhabitants of the earth! Glory be to the Kind and Compassionate! Glory be to the Oft-Forgiving and Merciful! Glory be to the Omnipotent and All-magnanimous! Glory be to the Indulgent and Liberal! Glory be to the Discerning and Wise! Glory be to the Comprehending, the All-Vast! Glory be to Allah at the coming of the day! Glory be to Allah at the departing of the day! Glory be to Allah at the departing of the night and the coming of the day! To Him alone is praise, might, greatness, and majesty, with every breath, every twinkle of an eye, and every moment already registered in His all-embracing knowledge. Glory be to You, as full as Your Book has enumerated! Glory be to You, equal to the weight of Your Throne! Glory be to You, glory be to You, glory be to You!
segs.tr: SUBHAANA MAY YA'LAMU JAWAARIHAL QULOOB, SUBHAANA MAY YUHSEE A'DADAZ ZUNOOB, SUBHAANA MAL LAA YAKHFAA A'LAYHI KHAAFIYATUN FIS SAMAAWAATI WAL ARADEEN, SUBHAANAR RABBIL WADOOD, SUBHAANAL FARDIL WITR, SUBHAANAL A'ZEEMIL A'ZAM, SUBHAANA MAL LAA YA'TADEE A'LAA AHLI MAMLAKATIH, SUBHAANA MAL LAA YU-AAKHIZU AHLAL ARDI BI-ALWAANIL A'ZAAB, SUBHAANAL HANNAANIL MANNAAN, SUBHAANAR RA-OOFIR RAHEEM, SUBHAANAL JABBAARIL JAWAAD, SUBHAANAL KAREEMIL HALEEM, SUBHAANAL BASEERIL A'LEEM, SUBHAANAL BASEERIL WAASI-A', SUBHAANAL LAAHI A'LAA IQBAALIN NAHAAR, SUBHAANAL LAAHI A'LAA IDBAARIN NAHAAR, SUBHAANAL LAAHI A'LAA IDBAARIL LAYLI WA IQBAALIN NAHAAR, WA LAHUL HAMDU WAL MAJDU WAL A'ZAMATU WAL KIBRIYAAA-U MA-A' KULLI NAFASIW WA KULLI TARFATI A'YNIW WA KULLI LAMHATIN SABAQA FEE I'LMIH, SUBHAANAKA MIL-A MAAA AHSAA KITAABUK, SUBHAANAKA ZINATA A'RSHIK, SUBHAANAKA SUBHAANAKA SUBHAANAK.

segs.note: It is worth mentioning that scholars have confirmed that the intention (niyyah) of fasting is preferably declared after the sahar meal.
segs.ur: قابل ذکر ہے کہ علما نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ روزے کی نیت سحری کے کھانے کے بعد کرنا بہتر ہے۔

segs.note: It is also permissible to intend fasting at any hour of the night.
segs.ur: یہ بھی جائز ہے کہ روزے کی نیت رات کے کسی بھی گھنٹے میں کر لی جائے۔

segs.note: It is sufficient, for the achievement of intention, to intend to observe fasting the next day for the sake of Almighty Allah and to abstain from having or doing any of the things or acts that break the fast.
segs.ur: نیت کے حاصل ہونے کے لیے یہی کافی ہے کہ اگلے دن اللہ تعالیٰ کی خاطر روزہ رکھنے اور روزہ توڑنے والی ہر چیز یا عمل سے بچنے کی نیت کی جائے۔

segs.note: It is also highly recommended not to neglect the famous Salat al-Layl (Night Prayer) and not to neglect the night worship.
segs.ur: یہ بھی بہت تاکید کی گئی ہے کہ مشہور نمازِ شب کو ترک نہ کریں اور شب کی عبادت میں غفلت نہ کریں۔

A_AA17.merits: As mentioned in Iqbal al-A'mal, it is recommended to say this doxology (zikr).
A_AA17.meritsUr: جیسا کہ اقبال الاعمال میں ذکر ہے، یہ ذکر پڑھنا مستحب ہے۔

A_AA18.name: Aamal & Duas for the Days of Ramazan

segs.en: O Allah, this is the month of Ramadan
in which You revealed the Qur'an,

segs.ar: هُدَىً لِلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْهُدٰى وَالْفُرْقَانِ
segs.en: a guidance for humankind and clear proofs of true guidance and distinction (between the right and the wrong).
segs.tr: HUDAL LINNAASI WA BAYYINAATIN MINAL HUDAA WAL FURQAAN

segs.en: This is the month of observing fasting.
This is the month of acts of worship.
This is the month of turning to You (in penitence).
This is the month of repentance.
This is the month of forgiveness and mercy.
segs.tr: WA HAADHAA SHAHRUL MAGHFIRATI WAR RAHMAH

segs.ar: وَهٰذَا شَهْرُ الْعِتْقِ مِنَ النَّارِ وَالْفَوْزِ بِالْجَنَّةِ
segs.en: This is the month of release from Hellfire and winning Paradise.
segs.tr: WA HAADHAA SHAHRUL I'TQI MINAN NAARI WAL FAWZI BIL JANNAH

segs.en: This is the month in which there is the Destiny Night,
segs.tr: WA HAADHAA SHAHRUN FEEHI LAYLATUL QADR

segs.ar: الَّتِيْ هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
segs.en: which is better than one thousand months.
segs.tr: ALLATEE HIYA KHAYRUN MIN ALFI SHAHR

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: help me observe fasting and do acts of worship during it,
segs.tr: WA A'INNEE A'LAA SIYAAMIHEE WA QIYAAMIH

segs.en: keep it upright for me, keep me safe during it,
segs.tr: WA SALLIMHU LEE WA SALLIMNEE FEEH

segs.en: help me observe it with the best of Your help,

segs.ar: وَوَفِّقْنِيْ فِيْهِ لِطَاعَتِكَ وَطَاعَةِ رَسُولِكَ وَاَوْلِيَآئِكَ
segs.en: make me succeed in doing acts of obedience to You, to Your Prophet, and Your intimate servants
segs.tr: WA WAFFIQNEE FEEHI LITAA'ATIKA WA TAA'ATI RASOOLIKA WA AWLIYAA'IK

segs.en: upon whom be Your blessings.

segs.ar: وَفَرِّغْنِي فِيْهِ لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَدُعَآئِكَ وَتِلَاوَةِ كِتَابِكَ
segs.en: Make me devote myself to acts of worship to You, to praying You, and to reciting Your Book,
segs.tr: WA FARRIGHNEE FEEHI LI-I'BAADATIKA WA DU'AA'IKA WA TILAAWATI KITAABIK

segs.en: increase its blessings for me,
confer upon me with good health during it,
make my body healthy during it,
expand my sustenance during it,
save me from whatever aggrieves me during it,
respond to my prayers during it,
and make me attain my hope during it.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاَذْهِبْ عَنِّي فِيْهِ النُّعَاسَ وَالْكَسَلَ وَالسَّاْمَةَ
segs.en: remove from me during it drowsiness, lethargy, laziness,
segs.tr: WA ADH-HIB A'NNEE FEEHIN NU'AASA WAL KASALA WAS SA'MAH

segs.en: weariness, hardheartedness, inattentiveness, and carelessness.
segs.tr: WAL FATRATA WAL QASWATA WAL GHAFLATA WAL GHIRRAH

segs.en: Put aside from me during it illnesses, sicknesses,
segs.tr: WA JANNIBNEE FEEHIL I'LALA WAL ASQAAM

segs.en: grievances, sorrows,
ailments, diseases,
wrongdoings, and sins.
Send away from me during it evil, indecency,
segs.tr: WASRIF A'NNEE FEEHIS SOO'A WAL FAHSHAA'

segs.en: fatigue, ordeals,
tiredness, and suffering.
Verily, You are the Hearer of prayers.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: and protect me during it from Satan the cursed,
segs.tr: WA A'IDHNEE FEEHI MINASH SHAYTAANIR RAJEEM

segs.en: his sting, his slander, his devilry,
segs.tr: WA HAMZIHEE WA LAMZIHEE WA NAFTHIHEE WA NAFKHIH

segs.en: his evil inspirations, his frustration, his obstinacy, his trickeries,
segs.tr: WA WASWASATIHEE WA TATHBEETIHEE WA BATSHIHEE WA KAYDIH

segs.en: his deceptions, his traps, his scams, his false hopes,
segs.tr: WA MAKRIHEE WA HABAA'ILIHEE WA KHUDA'IHEE WA AMAANIYYIH

segs.en: his vanities, his seductions, his ruses, his allies,
segs.tr: WA GHUROORIHEE WA FITNATIHEE WA SHARAKIHEE WA AHZAABIH

segs.en: his followers, his fans, his supporters, his partners,
segs.tr: WA ATBAA'IHEE WA ASHYAA'IHEE WA AWLIYAA'IHEE WA SHURAKAA'IH

segs.en: and all his snares.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: and bestow upon us with the observance of fasting, acts of worship,
attainment of our hopes during it, by means of doing acts of worship in it,
segs.tr: WA BULOOGHAL AMALI FEEHI WA FEE QIYAAMIH

segs.en: accomplishment of that which brings about Your pleasure
by means of steadfastness, acting for Your sake, faith and certitude.
segs.tr: SABRAN WAHTISAABAN WA EEMAANAN WA YAQEENAA

segs.ar: ثُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ ذٰلِكَ مِنِّيْ بِالْاَضْعَافِ الْكَثِيْرَةِ
segs.en: Then (please) admit all that from me with manifold rewards
segs.tr: THUMMA TAQABBAL DHAALIKA MINNEE BIL AD'AAFIL KATHEERAH

segs.en: and great gifts.
O Lord of the worlds!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: and grant me (the opportunity to go on) Hajj, 'Umrah,
hard work, painstakingness,
power, activity,
turning to You, repentance,
success, seeking Your nearness,
admitted good-doing, desire (for You), fear (from You),
segs.tr: WAL KHAYRAL MAQBOOLA WAR RAGHBATA WAR RAHBAH

segs.en: submission (to You), meekness,
tenderness, sincere intention,
truthfulness,
dread from You,
hope for You,
reliance upon You,
trust in You,
and abstention from committing that which You have deemed unlawful,
along with decent speaking,
admitted efforts,
elevated deeds,
and responded prayers.

segs.ar: وَلَا تَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ شَيْءٍ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ
segs.en: Do not let anything intervene between me and any of these matters,
segs.tr: WA LAA TAHUL BAYNEE WA BAYNA SHAY'IN MIN DHAALIK

segs.en: such as an accidental event, disease,
grief, unhappiness,
segs.tr: WA LAA HAMMIN WA LAA GHAMM

segs.ar: وَلَا سُقْمٍ وَلَا غَفْلَةٍ وَلَا نِسْيَانٍ
segs.en: ailment, inadvertence, or oblivion;
segs.tr: WA LAA SUQMIN WA LAA GHAFLATIN WA LAA NISYAAN

segs.en: rather, (help me do all that) with observance, carefulness to You and for Your sake,
segs.tr: BAL BIT TA'AAHUDI WAT TAHAFFUZI LAKA WA FEEK

segs.en: adherence to that which is incumbent upon me towards You, and fulfillment of my covenant and promise to You.
segs.tr: WAR RI'AAYATI LIHAQQIKA WAL WAFAA'I BI-A'HDIKA WA WA'DIK

segs.en: (let all that be) in the name of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَاقْسِمْ لِي فِيْهِ اَفْضَلَ مَا تَقْسِمُهٗ لِعِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
segs.en: decide for me during this month the best of that which You decide for Your righteous servants,
segs.tr: WAQSIM LEE FEEHI AFDALA MAA TAQSIMUHOO LI-I'BAADIKAS SAALIHEEN

segs.ar: وَاَعْطِنِيْ فِيْهِ اَفْضَلَ مَا تُعْطِيْ اَوْلِيَآءَكَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ
segs.en: and give me during it the most favorable of that which You give to Your intimate and favorite servants;
segs.tr: WA A'TINEE FEEHI AFDALA MAA TU'TEE AWLIYAA'AKAL MUQARRABEEN

segs.en: such as mercy, forgiveness, kindness, responding (of prayers),
segs.tr: MINAR RAHMATI WAL MAGHFIRATI WAT TAHANNUNI WAL IJAABAH

segs.en: pardon, perpetual forgiveness, good health, continuous wellbeing,
segs.tr: WAL A'FWI WAL MAGHFIRATID DAA'IMATI WAL A'AFIYATI WAL MU'AAFAAH

segs.en: release from Hellfire, winning Paradise,
segs.tr: WAL I'TQI MINAN NAARI WAL FAWZI BIL JANNAH

segs.en: and the goodness of this worldly life and the Next World.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: and cause my prayers during this month to reach You,
Your mercy and goodness during it to reach me,
segs.tr: WA RAHMATAKA WA KHAYRAKA ILAYYA FEEHI NAAZILAA

segs.en: my deed to be accepted (by You),
my efforts during it to be praiseworthy,
and my sins during it to be forgiven
so that my share (of Your awards) shall be the most abundant,
and my portion the most copious.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: and guide me to observe the Destiny Night adequately,

segs.ar: عَلٰى اَفْضَلِ حَالٍ تُحِبُّ اَنْ يَكُوْنَ عَلَيْهَا اَحَدٌ مِنْ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ وَاَرْضَاهَا لَكَ
segs.en: being in the most favorable and most pleased state that You would like to notice from any of Your intimate servants.
segs.tr: A'LAA AFDALI HAALIN TUHIBBU AN YAKOONA A'LAYHAA AHADUN MIN AWLIYAA'IKA WA ARDAAHAA LAK

segs.ar: ثُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا لِيْ خَيْرًا مِنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
segs.en: Then, decide it to be better for me than one thousand months,
segs.tr: THUMMAJ A'LHAA LEE KHAYRAN MIN ALFI SHAHR

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِيْ فِيْهَا اَفْضَلَ مَا رَزَقْتَ اَحَدًا مِمَّنْ بَلَّغْتَهٗ اِيَّاهَا وَاَكْرَمْتَهٗ بِهَا
segs.en: confer upon me during this night the best conferrals that You ever confer upon any one whom You guide to attain it and whom You honor during it,
segs.tr: WARZUQNEE FEEHAA AFDALA MAA RAZAQTA AHADAN MIMMAN BALLAGHTAHOO IYYAAHAA WA AKRAMTAHOO BIHAA

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْهَا مِنْ عُتَقَآئِكَ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ
segs.en: include me at this night it with those whom You release from Hell
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNEE FEEHAA MIN U'TAQAA'IKA MIN JAHANNAM

segs.en: whom You manumit from Hellfire
and with those of Your creatures who are happy due to Your forgiveness and satisfaction (that reach them).
segs.tr: WA SU'ADAA'I KHALQIKA BIMAGHFIRATIKA WA RIDWAANIK

segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنَا فِيْ شَهْرِنَا هٰذَا الْجِدَّ وَالْاِجْتِهَادَ
segs.en: and grant us during this month hard working, exactness,
segs.tr: WARZUQNAA FEE SHAHRINAA HAADHAL JIDDA WAL IJTIHAAD

segs.en: power, activeness,
and whatever You like and please.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ الْفَجْرِ وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ
segs.en: O Allah, the Lord of the Dawn, the Ten Nights, the Even and the Odd,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA RABBAL FAJRI WA LAYAALIN A'SHRIN WASH SHAF'I WAL WATR

segs.ar: وَرَبَّ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَمَا اَنْزَلْتَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِ
segs.en: the Lord of the month of Ramadan and the Qur'an that You have revealed during it,
segs.tr: WA RABBA SHAHRI RAMADAANA WA MAA ANZALTA FEEHI MINAL QUR'AAN

segs.en: the Lord of (Archangels) Gabriel, Michael, Seraph, and 'Izra’il,
segs.tr: WA RABBA JABRA'EELA WA MEEKAA'EELA WA ISRAAFEELA WA I'ZRAA'EEL

segs.en: as well as all the Favorite Angels,
the Lord of (Prophets) Abraham, Ishmael,
Isaac, and Jacob,
the Lord of Moses and Jesus,
as well as all the Prophets and Messengers,
and the Lord of Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets,
may Your blessings be upon him and upon them all.
I beseech You in the name of their duty towards You Your duty towards them,
segs.tr: WA AS'ALUKA BIHAQQIKA A'LAYHIM WA BIHAQQIHIM A'LAYK

segs.ar: وَبِحَقِّكَ الْعَظِيْمِ لَمَّا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
segs.en: and in the name of the great duty towards You to bless him and his Household and all of them,
segs.tr: WA BIHAQQIKAL A'ZEEMI LAMMAA SALLAYTA A'LAYHI WA AALIHEE WA A'LAYHIM AJMA'EEN

segs.en: to take a merciful look at me

segs.ar: تَرْضٰى بِهَا عَنِّي رِضىً لَا سَخَطَ عَلَيَّ بَعْدَهٗ اَبَدًا
segs.en: due to which You be pleased with me so perfectly that You never be irate with me after that,
segs.tr: TARDAA BIHAA A'NNEE RIDAN LAA SAKHATA A'LAYYA BA'DAHOO ABADAA

segs.ar: وَاَعْطَيْتَنِيْ جَمِيْعَ سُؤْلِيْ وَرَغْبَتِيْ وَاُمْنِيَّتِيْ وَاِرَادَتِيْ
segs.en: to grant me all my requests, desires, hopes, and needs,
segs.tr: WA A'TAYTANEE JAMEE'A SU'LEE WA RAGHBATEE WA UMNIYYATEE WA IRAADATEE

segs.en: to ward off all that which I despise and try to avoid
segs.tr: WA SARAFTA A'NNEE MAA AKRAHOO WA AHDHAR

segs.ar: وَاَخَافُ عَلٰى نَفْسِيْ وَمَا لَا اَخَافُ
segs.en: and all that which I fear for myself and all that which I do not fear,
segs.tr: WA AKHAAFU A'LAA NAFSEE WA MAA LAA AKHAAF

segs.en: and to do the same to my family members, my property, my brethren and my offspring.
segs.tr: WA A'N AHLEE WA MAALEE WA IKHWAANEE WA DHURRIYYATEE

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِلَيْكَ فَرَرْنَا مِنْ ذُنُوْبِنَا فَاٰوِنَا تَآئِبِيْنَ
segs.en: O Allah, to You are we running from our sins; so (please do) shelter us as we are repentant,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA ILAYKA FARARNAA MIN DHUNOOBINAA FA-AAWINAA TAA'IBEEN

segs.en: accept our repentance as we are seeking Your forgiveness,
forgive us as we are seeking Your protection,
protect us as we are seeking Your aid,
aid us as we are surrendering to You,
never disappoint us as we are fearful of You,
secure us as we are desiring for You,
accept our intercession as we are begging You,

segs.ar: وَاَعْطِنَا اِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَآءِ قَرِيْبٌ مُجِيْبٌ
segs.en: and grant us (what we hope) as You are verily the Hearer of prayers, the Nigh, and the Responding.
segs.tr: WA A'TINAA INNAKA SAMEE'UD DU'AA'I QAREEBUN MUJEEB

segs.en: O Allah, You are my Lord and I am Your servant,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA ANTA RABBEE WA ANAA A'BDUK

segs.en: and it is conventional that a servant begs from his Lord.
segs.tr: WA AHAQQU MAN SA'ALAL A'BDU RABBAH

segs.ar: وَلَمْ يَسْاَلِ الْعِبَادُ مِثْلَكَ كَرَمًا وَجُوْدًا
segs.en: All Your servants have never begged any one who is as generous and magnanimous as You are.
segs.tr: WA LAM YAS'ALIL I'BAADU MITHLAKA KARAMAN WA JOODAA

segs.en: O center of the complaints of the beseechers!
O ultimate goal of the needs of the desirers!
O Aide of the seekers of aid!
O Responding to the prayers of the distressed ones!
O Shelter of the fugitives!
O Helper of the seekers of help!
O Cherisher of the enfeebled ones!
O Reliever of the grievances of the aggrieved ones!
O Releaser of the agonies of the distressed ones!
O Reliever of the enormous calamities!

segs.ar: يَا اَللهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيْمُ
segs.en: O Allah! O All-beneficent! O All-merciful!
segs.tr: YAA ALLAAHU YAA RAHMAANU YAA RAHEEM

segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
(Please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: forgive my sins, my defects,
my offenses, my wrongdoing, my felonies,
segs.tr: WA ISAA'ATEE WA ZULMEE WA JURMEE

segs.en: and my extravagance in my affairs,
grant me out of Your favors and mercy,
for none possesses these two save You,
pardon me,

segs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ كُلَّ مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوْبِيْ
segs.en: forgive all my past sins,
segs.tr: WAGHFIR LEE KULLA MAA SALAFA MIN DHUNOOBEE

segs.en: save me from sinning in the rest of my lifetime,
cover me as well as my parents,
my children, my relatives, my friends,
segs.tr: WA WALADEE WA QARAABATEE WA AHLI HUZAANATEE

segs.ar: وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنِّي بِسَبِيْلٍ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ
segs.en: and all those who relate to me from the believing men and women in this worldly life and the life to come.
segs.tr: WA MAN KAANA MINNEE BISABEELIN MINAL MU'MINEENA WAL MU'MINAATI FID DUNYAA WAL AAKHIRAH

segs.en: Verily, all that is managed by You alone
and You are verily the Liberal in forgiving.
So, my Master, do not disappoint me,

segs.ar: وَلَا تَرُدَّ دُعَآئِيْ وَلَا يَدِيْ اِلٰى نَحْرِيْ
segs.en: do not reject my prayer, and do not let me down;
segs.tr: WA LAA TARUDDA DU'AA'EE WA LAA YADEE ILAA NAHREE

segs.ar: حَتّٰى تَفْعَلَ ذٰلِكَ بِيْ وَتَسْتَجِيْبَ لِيْ جَمِيْعَ مَا سَاَلْتُكَ
segs.en: rather, (please) do all that to me, respond to me in all that which I have asked from You,
segs.tr: HATTAA TAF'ALA DHAALIKA BEE WA TASTAJEEBA LEE JAMEE'A MAA SA'ALTUK

segs.en: and increase Your favor upon me,
because You verily have power over all things
and for You do we desire.
O Allah, Yours are the Most Excellent Names,
the Most Elevated Examples,
every greatness, and all bounties.
I thus beseech You by Your Name:
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segs.ar: اِنْ كُنْتَ قَضَيْتَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ
segs.en: If you have decided at this night,
segs.tr: IN KUNTA QADAYTA FEE HAADHIHIL LAYLAH

segs.en: during which the angels and the Holy Spirit are allowed to descend,

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: add my name to the (list of the) happy ones,
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ'ALAS MEE FIS SU'ADAA'

segs.en: add my soul to the martyrs,
elevate my good doings exaltedly,
decide my ill deeds to be forgiven,

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَهَبَ لِيْ يَقِيْنًا تُبَاشِرُ بِهٖ قَلْبِيْ
segs.en: grant me conviction with which You fill in my heart,
segs.tr: WA AN TAHABA LEE YAQEENAN TUBAASHIRU BIHEE QALBEE

segs.en: faith free of doubt,
satisfaction with that which You decide for me,

segs.ar: وَاٰتِنِيْ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
segs.en: grant me good in this worldly life and good in the Next World,
segs.tr: WA AATINEE FID DUNYAA HASANATAN WA FIL AAKHIRATI HASANAH

segs.en: and save me from the Fire of Hell.

segs.ar: وَاِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ قَضَيْتَ فِيْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ
segs.en: And if You have not decided at this night,
segs.tr: WA IN LAM TAKUN QADAYTA FEE HAADHIHIL LAYLAH

segs.en: during which the angels and the Holy Spirit are allowed to descend,
then (please) postpone Your decisions about me to that night,
confer upon me during it with remembering You, showing gratitude to You,
doing acts of obedience to You, and worshipping You in the best manner.
And (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: WA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: with Your most favorable blessings, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O One and Only! the Besought of all!
O Lord of Muhammad!
(please) revenge on this day for Muhammad and for the pious ones from his offspring,
segs.tr: IGHDABIL YAWMA LIMUHAMMADIN WA LI-ABRAARI I'TRATIH

segs.en: eradicate all of their enemies,
put them all under Your reprimand,

segs.ar: وَلَا تَدَعْ عَلٰى ظَهْرِ الْاَرْضِ مِنْهُمْ اَحَدًا
segs.en: do not leave anyone of them to live on this earth,
segs.tr: WA LAA TADA' A'LAA ZAHRIL ARDI MINHUM AHADAA

segs.en: and never forgive them.
O most excellent Companion!
O Heir of the Prophets!
You are verily the most Merciful of all those who show mercy,
the Commencer, the brilliant Maker,
there is none like You,
You are the Eternal Who never omits anything,
are the Ever-living Who never dies,
on each day, You have a certain state.
You are the Heir of Muhammad,
the Supporter of Muhammad,
and the Selector of Muhammad.

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تَنْصُرَ وَصِيَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَخَلِيْفَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: I beseech You to give victory to the successor and representative of Muhammad,
segs.tr: AS'ALUKA AN TANSURA WASIYYA MUHAMMADIN WA KHALEEFATA MUHAMMAD

segs.en: the Imam who shall appear with justice among the successors of Muhammad,
segs.tr: WAL QAA'IMA BIL QISTI MIN AWSIYAA'I MUHAMMAD

segs.en: may Your blessings be upon him and upon them.
(Please) turn Your victory toward them.
O He but Whom there is no god!
I beseech You in the name of that there is no god but You,
(please do) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: allow me to join them in this worldly life as well as the Next World
segs.tr: WAJ'ALNEE MA'AHUM FID DUNYAA WAL AAKHIRAH

segs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ عَاقِبَةَ اَمْرِيْ اِلٰى غُفْرَانِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
segs.en: and allow all my affairs to end up with Your forgiveness and mercy.
segs.tr: WAJ'AL A'AQIBATA AMREE ILAA GHUFRAANIKA WA RAHMATIK

segs.en: O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

segs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ نَسَبْتَ نَفْسَكَ يَا سَيِّدِيْ بِاللَّطِيْفِ
segs.en: O my Master, You have ascribed the feature of kindness to Yourself.
segs.tr: WA KADHAALIKA NASABTA NAFSAKA YAA SAYYIDEE BIL LATEEF

segs.en: Yes, indeed! You are truly kind.
So, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
segs.tr: FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: and treat me kindly as You like.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِى الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ فِيْ عَامِنَا هٰذَا
segs.en: grant me (the opportunity to go on) Hajj and 'Umrah in this year,
segs.tr: WARZUQNIL HAJJA WAL U'MRATA FEE A'AMINAA HAADHAA

segs.ar: وَتَطَوَّلْ عَلَيَّ بِجَمِيْعِ حَوَآئِجِيْ لِلْاٰخِرَةِ وَالدُّنْيَا
segs.en: confer upon me with the favor of settling all my needs for the Next World and this worldly life.
segs.tr: WA TATAWWAL A'LAYYA BIJAMEE'I HAWAA'IJEE LIL AAKHIRATI WAD DUNYAA

segs.note: Then recite 3 times:

segs.en: I implore for the forgiveness of Allah, my Lord, and I repent before Him.
Surely, my Lord is Nigh and Responding.
I implore for Allah’s forgiveness, my Lord, and I repent before Him,
Surely, my Lord is Merciful, Loving.
I implore for Allah’s forgiveness, my Lord, and I repent before Him.
He is surely All-forgiving.
O Allah, (please do) forgive me.
You are verily the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

segs.ar: رَبِّ اِنِّيْ عَمِلْتُ سُوٓءًا وَظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ
segs.en: O my Lord, I have committed ill deeds and wronged myself.
segs.tr: RABBI INNEE A'MILTU SOO'AN WA ZALAMTU NAFSEE

segs.ar: فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ اِنَّهٗ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
segs.en: So (please) forgive me, because none can forgive sins save You.
segs.tr: FAGHFIR LEE INNAHOO LAA YAGHFIRUDH DHUNOOBA ILLAA ANT

segs.ar: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِيْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ
segs.en: I implore for Allah’s forgiveness save Whom there is no god,
segs.tr: ASTAGHFIRULLAAHAL LADHEE LAA ILAAHA ILLAA HUW

segs.en: the Ever-living, the Self-Subsistent, the Indulgent, the All-great,
the Noble, the forgiver of fatal sins,
and I repent before Him.
I implore for Allah’s forgiveness.
Allah is verily Forgiver, Merciful.

segs.note: Then keep on reciting:

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segs.en: O Allah, I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE AS'ALUKA AN TUSALLIYA A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD

segs.en: to decide within the decisions that You make,
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ'ALA FEEMAA TAQDEE WA TUQADDIR

segs.ar: مِنَ الْاَمْرِ الْعَظِيْمِ الْمَحْتُومِ فِيْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
segs.en: from the great, inevitable affair at the Destiny Night,
segs.tr: MINAL AMRIL A'ZEEMIL MAHTOOMI FEE LAYLATIL QADR

segs.ar: مِنَ الْقَضَآءِ الَّذِيْ لَا يُرَدُّ وَلَا يُبَدَّلُ
segs.en: within the decision that is neither rejected nor altered,
segs.tr: MINAL QADAA'IL LADHEE LAA YURADDU WA LAA YUBADDAL

segs.ar: اَنْ تَكْتُبَنِيْ مِنْ حُجَّاجِ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ
segs.en: to write my name with the pilgrims of Your Holy House,
segs.tr: AN TAKTUBANEE MIN HUJJAAJI BAYTIKAL HARAAM

segs.en: whose Hajj is admitted,
whose efforts are praiseworthy,
whose sins are forgiven,
and whose offenses are pardoned,

segs.ar: وَاَنْ تَجْعَلَ فِيْمَا تَقْضِيْ وَتُقَدِّرُ اَنْ تُطِيْلَ عُمْرِيْ
segs.en: to decide among the decisions that You make to grant me long lifetime,
segs.tr: WA AN TAJ'ALA FEEMAA TAQDEE WA TUQADDIRU AN TUTEELA U'MREE

segs.en: expand my sustenance,
help me fulfill my trusts and settle my debts,
segs.tr: WA TU'ADDIYA A'NNEE AMAANATEE WA DAYNEE

segs.en: and respond to me, O Lord of the worlds.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِيْ مِنْ اَمْرِيْ فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا
segs.en: O Allah, (please do) make for me relief and an outlet,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMAJ A'L LEE MIN AMREE FARAJAN WA MAKHRAJAA

segs.ar: وَارْزُقْنِيْ مِنْ حَيْثُ اَحْتَسِبُ وَمِنْ حَيْثُ لَا اَحْتَسِبُ
segs.en: provide for me from whence I expect and from whence I do not expect,
segs.tr: WARZUQNEE MIN HAYTHU AHTASIBU WA MIN HAYTHU LAA AHTASIB

segs.ar: وَاحْرُسْنِيْ مِنْ حَيْثُ اَحْتَرِسُ وَمِنْ حَيْثُ لَا اَحْتَرِسُ
segs.en: guard me from when I take precautions and from whence I do not take precautions,
segs.tr: WAHRUSNEE MIN HAYTHU AHTARISU WA MIN HAYTHU LAA AHTARIS

segs.ar: وَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَسَلِّمْ كَثِيْرًا
segs.en: and send plentiful blessings and benedictions to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
segs.tr: WA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMADIN WA SALLIM KATHEERAA

A_AA18.merits: It is recommended to say this supplicatory prayer on the days of Ramadan; it is mentioned by Shaykh al-Tusi and Sayyid Ibn Tawus.
A_AA18.meritsUr: ماہ رمضان کے دنوں میں یہ دعا پڑھنا مستحب ہے؛ اسے شیخ طوسی اور سید ابن طاؤس نے ذکر کیا ہے۔

A_AA19.name: Tasbeehat & Salawat for Every Day in Ramazan

segs.note: It is also recommended to say the following doxology every day in Ramadan. It consists of ten parts, each part comprising ten phrases of glorification of Almighty Allah:
segs.ur: یہ بھی مستحب ہے کہ ماہ رمضان میں روزانہ درج ذیل تسبیح پڑھیں۔ یہ دس حصوں پر مشتمل ہے اور ہر حصے میں اللہ تعالیٰ کی تسبیح کے دس جملے ہیں:

segs.ar: ﴿١﴾ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بَارِئِ النَّسَمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ المُصَوِّرِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ الْاَزْوَاجِ كُلِّهَا، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ جَاعِلِ الظُّلُمَاتِ وَالنُّوْرِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ فَالِقِ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوٰى، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ مَا يُرٰى، وَمَا لَا يُرٰى سُبْحَانَ اللهِ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ السَّمِيْعِ الَّذِيْ لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ اَسْمَعَ مِنْهُ، يَسْمَعُ مِنْ فَوْقِ عَرْشِهِ مَا تَحْتَ سَبْعِ اَرَضِيْنَ، وَيَسْمَعُ مَا فِيْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ، وَيَسْمَعُ الْاَنِيْنَ وَالشَّكْوٰى وَيَسْمَعُ السِّرَّ وَاَخْفٰى، وَيَسْمَعُ وَسَاوِسَ الصُّدُوْرِ وَلَا يُصِمُّ سَمْعَهُ صَوْتٌ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah, the Shaper of souls; glory be to Allah, the Fashioner; glory be to Allah, Creator of all pairs; glory be to Allah, Maker of darkness and light; glory be to Allah, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone; glory be to Allah, Creator of all things; glory be to Allah, Creator of the seen and the unseen; glory be to Allah, as much as the ink of His words; glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds; glory be to Allah, the All-Hearing, than Whom nothing hears more — He hears, from above His Throne, what is beneath the seven earths; He hears what is in the darkness of land and sea; He hears the moan and the complaint; He hears the secret and what is more hidden than the secret; He hears the whispers of hearts, and no sound can ever deafen His hearing.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAL LAAHI BAARI-IN NASAM, SUBHAANAL LAAHIL MUSAWWIR, SUBHAANAL LAAHI KHAALIQIL AZWAAJI KULLIHAA, SUBHAANAL LAAHI JAAA-I'LIZ ZULUMAATI WAN NOOR, SUBHAANAL LAAHI FAALIQIL HABBI WAN NAWAA, SUBHAANAL LAAHI KHAALIQI KULLI SHAY-IN, SUBHAANAL LAAHI KHAALIQI MAA YURAA WA MAA LAA YURAA, SUBHAANAL LAAHI MIDAADA KALIMAATIH, SUBHAANAL LAAHI RABBIL A'ALAMEEN, SUBHAANAL LAAHIS SAMEE-I'L LAZEE LAYSA SHAY-UN ASMA-A' MINHU, YASMA-U' MIN FAWQI A'RSHIHI MAA TAHTA SAB-I' ARADEEN, WA YASMA-U' MAA FEE ZULUMAATIL BARRI WAL BAHR, WA YASMA-U'L ANEENA WASH SHAKWAA WA YASMA-U'S SIRRA WA AKHFAA, WA YASMA-U' WASAAWISAS SUDOORI WA LAA YUSIMMU SAM-A'HU SAWT.

segs.ar: ﴿٢﴾ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بَارِئِ النَّسَمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الُمُصَوِّرِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ الْاَزْوَاجِ كُلِّهَا، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ جَاعِلِ الظُّلُمَاتِ وَالنُّوْرِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ فَالِقِ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوٰى، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ مَا يُرٰى وَمَا لَا يُرٰى، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْبَصيرِ الَّذِيْ لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ اَبْصَرَ مِنْهُ، يُبْصِرُ مِنْ فَوْقِ عَرْشِهِ مَا تَحْتَ سَبْعِ اَرَضِيْنَ، وَيُبْصِرُ مَا فِيْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ، لَا تُدْرِكُهُ الْاَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْاَبْصَارَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيْفُ الْخَبِيْرُ، لَا تُغْشِىْ بَصَرَهُ الظُّلْمَةُ، وَلَا يُسْتَتَرُ مِنْهُ بِسِتْرٍ، وَلَا يُوَارِيْ مِنْهُ جِدَارٌ، وَلَا يَغِيْبُ عَنْهُ بَرٌّ وَلَا بَحْرٌ، وَلَا يَكُنُّ مِنْهُ جَبَلٌ مَا فِيْ اَصْلِهِ، وَلَا قَلْبٌ مَا فِيْهِ، وَلَا جَنْبٌ مَا فِيْ قَلْبِهِ، وَلَا يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْهُ صَغِيْرٌ وَلَا كَبِيْرٌ، وَلَا يَسْتَخْفِيْ مِنْهُ صَغِيْرٌ لِصِغَرِهِ، وَلَا يَخْفٰى عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَآءِ، هُوَ الَّذِيْ يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِي الْاَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ، لَا اِلـٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
segs.en: Glory be to Allah, the Shaper of souls; glory be to Allah, the Fashioner; glory be to Allah, Creator of all pairs; glory be to Allah, Maker of darkness and light; glory be to Allah, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone; glory be to Allah, Creator of all things; glory be to Allah, Creator of the seen and the unseen; glory be to Allah, as much as the ink of His words; glory be to Allah, Lord of the worlds; glory be to Allah, the All-Seeing, than Whom nothing sees more — He sees, from above His Throne, what is beneath the seven earths; He sees what is in the darkness of land and sea; sights cannot perceive Him while He perceives all sights, and He is the Subtle, the Aware; no darkness can veil His sight, no screen can conceal Him, no wall can hide Him, no land and no sea is ever absent from Him; no mountain can conceal from Him what is in its base, nor any heart what is in it, nor any breast what is in its heart; nothing small or great can hide from Him, nor can the smallest thing be concealed from Him for its smallness; nothing in the earth or the heaven is ever hidden from Him. He it is Who fashions you in the wombs as He pleases; there is no god save Him, the Almighty, the All-wise.
segs.tr: SUBHAANAL LAAHI BAARI-IN NASAM, SUBHAANAL LAAHIL MUSAWWIR, SUBHAANAL LAAHI KHAALIQIL AZWAAJI KULLIHAA, SUBHAANAL LAAHI JAAA-I'LIZ ZULUMAATI WAN NOOR, SUBHAANAL LAAHI FAALIQIL HABBI WAN NAWAA, SUBHAANAL LAAHI KHAALIQI KULLI SHAY-IN, SUBHAANAL LAAHI KHAALIQI MAA YURAA WA MAA LAA YURAA, SUBHAANAL LAAHI MIDAADA KALIMAATIH, SUBHAANAL LAAHI RABBIL A'ALAMEEN, SUBHAANAL LAAHIL BASEERIL LAZEE LAYSA SHAY-UN ABSARA MINHU, YUBSIRU MIN FAWQI A'RSHIHI MAA TAHTA SAB-I' ARADEEN, WA YUBSIRU MAA FEE ZULUMAATIL BARRI WAL BAHR, LAA TUDRIKUHUL ABSAARU WA HUWA YUDRIKUL ABSAAR WA HUWAL LATEEFUL KHABEER, LAA TUGHSHIL BASARAHUZ ZULMAH, WA LAA YUSTATARU MINHU BI-SITR, WA LAA YUWAAREE MINHU JIDAAR, WA LAA YAGHEEBU A'NHU BARRUW WA LAA BAHR, WA LAA YAKUNNU MINHU JABALUM MAA FEE ASLIH, WA LAA QALBUM MAA FEEH, WA LAA JANBUM MAA FEE QALBIH, WA LAA YASTATIRU MINHU SAGHEERUW WA LAA KABEER, WA LAA YASTAKHFEE MINHU SAGHEERUL LI-SIGHARIH, WA LAA YAKHFAA A'LAYHI SHAY-UN FIL ARDI WA LAA FIS SAMAAA-I, HUWAL LAZEE YUSAWWIRUKUM FIL ARHAAMI KAYFA YASHAAA-O, LAA ILAAHA ILLAA HUWAL A'ZEEZUL HAKEEM.

segs.ar: ﴿٣﴾ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بَارِئِ النَّسَمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ المُصَوِّرِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ الْاَزْوَاجِ كُلِّهَا، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ جَاعِلِ الظُّلُمَاتِ وَالنُّوْرِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ فَالِقِ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوٰى، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ خَالِقِ مَا يُرٰى، وَمَا لَا يُرٰى سُبْحَانَ اللهِ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الَّذِيْ يُنْشِئُ السَّحَابَ الثِّقَالَ، وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ، وَالْمَلَآئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيْفَتِهِ، وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَاعِقِ فَيُصِيْبُ بِهَا مَنْ يَشَآءُ، وَيُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ، وَيُنَزِّلُ الْمَآءَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ بِكَلِمَتِهِ وَيُنْبِتُ النَّبَاتَ بِقُدْرَتِهِ، وَيَسْقُطُ الْوَرَقُ بِعِلْمِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الَّذِيْ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَآءِ، وَلَا اَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا اَكْبَرُ اِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِيْنٍ
