segs.ur: یہ بھی مستحب ہے کہ نمازِ عید کھلے میدان میں، پاؤں کے نیچے قالین یا کوئی اور چیز رکھے بغیر سیدھی زمین پر پڑھی جائے، جس راستے سے گئے ہوں اس سے مختلف راستے سے واپس آیا جائے، اور اپنے دینی بھائیوں کے اعمال کی قبولیت کے لیے اللہ سے دعا کی جائے۔

segs.note: Ziyarat & Dua Nudba
segs.ur: زیارت اور دعائے ندبہ

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.).
segs.ur: امام حسین (ع) کے روضۂ مبارک کی زیارت کریں۔

segs.note: Recite Dua Nudba.
segs.ur: دعائے ندبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After Dua Nudba, prostrate and say:
segs.ur: دعائے ندبہ کے بعد، سجدہ کریں اور کہیں:

segs.ar: اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَارٍ حَرُّهَا لَا يُطْفٰى
segs.en: I seek refuge with You from fire whose heat is never extinguished,
segs.tr: A’OOZO BEKA MINNAARIN HARROHAA LAA YUTFAA

segs.ar: وَجَدِيْدُهَا لَا يَبْلٰى وَعَطْشَانُهَا لَا يَرْوٰى
segs.en: whose fresh flame never deteriorates, and whose thirsty is never quenched.
segs.tr: WA JADEEDOHAA LAA YABLAA WA A’THAANOHAA LAA YARWAA

segs.note: You may then put your right cheek on the ground and say the following:
segs.ur: پھر اپنا دایاں رخسار زمین پر رکھیں اور یہ کہیں:

segs.ar: اِلٰهِيْ لَا تُقَلِّبْ وَجْهِيْ فِيْ النَّارِ بَعْدَ سُجُوْدِيْ
segs.en: O my God, (please) do not turn my face in Hellfire after I have prostrated myself
segs.tr: ELAAHEE LAA TOQALLIB WAJHEE FIN NAARE BA’DA SOJOODEE

segs.ar: وَتَعْفِيْرِىْ لَكَ بِغَيْرِ مَنٍّ مِنِّيْ عَلَيْكَ بَلْ لَكَ الْمَنُّ عَلَىَّ
segs.en: and soiled my face before You; it is not a show of favor from me to You, but it is You Who have this favor on me.
segs.tr: WA TA’FEEREE LAKA BE-GHAYRE MANNIN MINNEE A’LAYKA BAL LAKAL MANNO A’LAYYA

segs.note: You may then put your left cheek on the ground and say the following:
segs.ur: پھر اپنا بایاں رخسار زمین پر رکھیں اور یہ کہیں:

segs.ar: اِرْحَمْ مَنْ اَسَآءَ وَاقْتَرَفَ وَاسْتَكَانَ وَاعْتَرَفَ.
segs.en: Have mercy on one who has transgressed and committed blunders, but is now showing humility and confessing.
segs.tr: IRHAM MAN ASAA-A WAQ TARAFA WAS TAKAANA WA’TARAFA.

segs.note: You may then return to the (ordinary) prostration and say the following:
segs.ur: پھر آپ (معمول کے) سجدے میں واپس جا کر درج ذیل کہہ سکتے ہیں:

segs.ar: اِنْ كُنْتُ بِئْسَ الْعَبْدُ فَاَنْتَ نِعْمَ الرَّبُّ
segs.en: If I am the most miserable servant (of You), You are verily the best Lord.
segs.tr: IN KUNTO BEASAL A’BDO FA-ANTA NE’MAR RABBO

segs.en: Grand is the sin of Your servant;
so, let pardon of You be nice.
O All-noble.

segs.note: You may then repeat the following word one hundred times:
segs.ur: پھر آپ درج ذیل لفظ سو مرتبہ دہرا سکتے ہیں:

segs.en: (I plead for) pardon. (I plead for) pardon.

A_AD4.merits:
Prostrations after Dua Nudba: Sayyid Ibn Tawus has instructed this sequence.

Sayyid Ibn Tawus then adds, “Do not spend this day with entertainment and negligence while you do not know whether your deeds have been accepted or rejected. Rather, if you hope for acceptance of your deeds, you must show thanks; and if you anticipate rejection, you must be intensely sad.”

Twenty-fifth of Shawwal: According to some narrations, Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq (a.s.) departed life on the twenty fifth of Shawwal, AH 148. However, other historians have decided that he departed life on the fifteenth of Rajab. The reason of his death was that he was offered poisoned grapes. It has been also narrated that at his last hours, he (a.s.) gathered all his relatives and said to them, “Our Intercession (shafa’ah) shall not be won by him who belittles his prayers and who does not care for them.”
A_AD4.meritsUr:
دعائے ندبہ کے بعد سجدے: سید ابن طاؤس نے یہ ترتیب بیان فرمائی ہے۔

پھر سید ابن طاؤس مزید فرماتے ہیں: ”یہ دن کھیل کود اور غفلت میں نہ گزارو جبکہ تم نہیں جانتے کہ تمہارے اعمال قبول ہوئے یا رد کر دیے گئے۔ بلکہ اگر تمہیں اپنے اعمال کی قبولیت کی امید ہے تو شکر ادا کرو؛ اور اگر رد ہونے کا اندیشہ ہے تو بہت زیادہ غمگین ہو۔“

پچیس شوال: بعض روایات کے مطابق امام جعفر بن محمد صادق علیہ السلام نے پچیس شوال، ایک سو اڑتالیس ہجری کو وفات پائی۔ البتہ دوسرے مؤرخین کے نزدیک آپ کی وفات پندرہ رجب کو ہوئی۔ آپ کی وفات کا سبب یہ تھا کہ آپ کو زہر آلود انگور کھلائے گئے۔ یہ بھی روایت ہے کہ آپ علیہ السلام نے اپنی زندگی کے آخری لمحات میں اپنے تمام رشتہ داروں کو جمع کیا اور ان سے فرمایا: ”ہماری شفاعت اس شخص کو نصیب نہیں ہوگی جو نماز کو ہلکا سمجھے اور اس کی پروا نہ کرے۔“

A_AB1.name: Dhul Qa'dah - Sunday Namaz

segs.note: The method of this prayer is that one should bathe oneself on Sunday, do the ritual ablution (wuzu), and offer a four-unit prayer in each unit of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once, Surah al-Tawheed repeated three times, and Surahs al-Falaq and al-Naas recited once each. After that, the statement of imploring for forgiveness i.e. saying
segs.ur: اس نماز کا طریقہ یہ ہے کہ اتوار کے دن غسل کرے، وضو کرے اور چار رکعت نماز پڑھے جس کی ہر رکعت میں سورہ فاتحہ ایک مرتبہ، سورہ توحید تین مرتبہ اور سورہ فلق و سورہ ناس ایک ایک مرتبہ پڑھے۔ اس کے بعد استغفار کا جملہ، یعنی یہ کہے:

segs.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah, my Lord, and I turn to Him in repentance.
segs.tr: ASTAGHFERUL LAAHA RABBEE WA ATOOBO ELAYHE

segs.note: is repeated seventy times, and, finally, the following statement is said:
segs.ur: ستر مرتبہ دہرایا جاتا ہے، اور آخر میں یہ جملہ کہا جاتا ہے:

segs.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ
segs.en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the All-great.
segs.tr: LAA HAWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAHIL A’LIYYIL A’ZEEMO

segs.note: After that, the following supplicatory prayer is said:
segs.ur: اس کے بعد، درج ذیل دعا پڑھی جاتی ہے:

segs.ar: يَا عَزِيْزُ يَا غَفَّارُ اِغْفِرْ لِيْ ذُنُوْبِيْ
segs.en: O Almighty! O All-forgiving! Forgive my sins
segs.tr: YAA A’ZEEZO YAA GHAFFAARO IGHFIR LEE ZONOOBEE

segs.en: and the sins of all believing men and women,
segs.tr: WA ZONOOBA JAMEE-I’L MOAMENEENA WAL MOAMENAATE

segs.ar: فَاِنَّهٗ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ.
segs.en: for none can forgive sins save You.
segs.tr: FA-INNAHU LAA YAGHFERUZ ZONOOBA ILLAA ANTA.

segs.note: It is worth mentioning that a hadees reads that to observe fasting on three consecutive days in a sacred month; namely, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, brings about the reward of nine hundred year worship.
segs.ur: قابل ذکر ہے کہ ایک حدیث میں ہے کہ حرمت والے مہینے میں مسلسل تین دن، یعنی جمعرات، جمعہ اور ہفتہ کو روزہ رکھنے سے نو سو سال کی عبادت کا ثواب ملتا ہے۔

segs.note: The lofty Shaykh Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Qummi says, “The rewards of good deeds, as well as the punishments for evil deeds, are doubled in the sacred months.”
segs.ur: جلیل القدر شیخ علی بن ابراہیم قمی کہتے ہیں: «حرمت والے مہینوں میں نیک اعمال کا ثواب اور اسی طرح برے اعمال کی سزا دوگنی ہو جاتی ہے۔»

A_AB1.merits: The month of Zilqad is the first of the Sacred Months to which Almighty Allah has referred in the Holy Qur’an. Sayyid Ibn Tawus defines this month as the month of responding to the prayers in hardships. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) is reported as having mentioned a great reward for those who offer a special prayer on Sundays in Zilqad, adding that their repentance would be accepted, their sins forgiven, their rivals made pleased with them on the Resurrection Day, caused to die on true faith, given the true religion, granted expansion and light in the grave, the parents made pleased with them, their parents and offspring had their sins forgiven, provided with expansive sustenance, and granted lenience of the Angel of Death and easiness of their souls leaving their bodies.
A_AB1.meritsUr: ماہ ذی القعدہ حرمت والے مہینوں میں سے پہلا مہینہ ہے جن کا ذکر اللہ تعالیٰ نے قرآن مجید میں فرمایا ہے۔ سید ابن طاؤس اس مہینے کو سختیوں میں دعاؤں کی قبولیت کا مہینہ قرار دیتے ہیں۔ رسول اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم سے روایت ہے کہ آپ نے ذی القعدہ کے اتوار کے دن ایک خاص نماز پڑھنے والوں کے لیے بہت بڑا ثواب بیان فرمایا، اور فرمایا کہ ان کی توبہ قبول ہوگی، ان کے گناہ معاف ہوں گے، روز قیامت ان کے مخالف ان سے راضی کر دیے جائیں گے، انہیں ایمان پر موت آئے گی، انہیں سچا دین عطا ہوگا، ان کی قبر کشادہ اور روشن کی جائے گی، ان کے والدین ان سے راضی ہوں گے، ان کے والدین اور اولاد کے گناہ معاف کیے جائیں گے، انہیں وسیع رزق دیا جائے گا، اور ملک الموت ان پر نرمی کرے گا اور ان کی روح آسانی سے جسم سے نکلے گی۔

A_AB2.name: 11th, 15th & 23rd of Dhul Qa'dah

segs.note: 15th Night of Dhul Qa’dah
segs.ur: ذی القعدہ کی 15ویں رات

segs.note: Seize this excellent opportunity: practice acts of worship and obedience, offer prayers, and pray Almighty Allah for granting your needs.
segs.ur: اس بہترین موقع کو غنیمت جانیں: عبادت و اطاعت بجا لائیں، نماز پڑھیں اور اللہ تعالیٰ سے اپنی حاجات پوری ہونے کی دعا کریں۔

segs.note: 23rd: Visit Imam al-Rida (a.s.)
segs.ur: 23 تاریخ: امام رضا (ع) کی زیارت

segs.note: On the twenty-third of Dhu’l-Qa’dah, visit the holy tomb of Imam al-Rida (a.s.), from nearby or from far off, by one of the familiar forms of Ziyarah (see Ziyarat of Imam Ali al-Reza) or any other form.
segs.ur: ذی القعدہ کی تیئیسویں تاریخ کو امام رضا (ع) کے روضۂ مقدس کی زیارت کریں، قریب سے یا دور سے، زیارت کی معروف صورتوں میں سے کسی ایک کے ذریعے (دیکھیں زیارت امام علی رضا) یا کسی اور صورت سے۔

A_AB2.merits:
Eleventh of Dhu’l-Qa’dah: On the eleventh of Dhu’l-Qa’dah, AH 148, Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida(a.s.) was born.

15th night: The fifteenth night of Dhu’l-Qa’dah is a blessed night at which Almighty Allah observes His faithful servants with the eye of mercy. According to a tradition that is reported from the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.), one who practices acts of worship at this night will have the reward of one hundred fasters who confine themselves to mosques and who have never disobeyed Almighty Allah. In this respect, it has been narrated that Almighty Allah will respond to one who prays Him for any need at this night.

23rd: On the twenty-third of Dhu’l-Qa’dah, AH 200, Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida(a.s.) departed life, according to some narrations. Hence, it is familiar to visit his tomb on this day whether from nearby or from far off. In this respect, Sayyid Ibn Tawus, in Iqbal al-A’mal, says that he has seen in the book of some non-Arab scholars that it is recommended to visit the holy tomb of Imam al-Rida(a.s.) on the twenty-third of Dhu’l-Qa’dah from nearby or from far off by one of the familiar forms of Ziyarah or any other form.
A_AB2.meritsUr:
گیارہ ذی القعدہ: گیارہ ذی القعدہ، ایک سو اڑتالیس ہجری کو امام علی بن موسیٰ رضا علیہ السلام پیدا ہوئے۔

پندرہویں رات: ذی القعدہ کی پندرہویں رات ایک بابرکت رات ہے جس میں اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے مومن بندوں کو رحمت کی نظر سے دیکھتا ہے۔ رسول اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم سے منقول ایک روایت کے مطابق جو شخص اس رات عبادت کرے اسے ان سو روزہ داروں کا ثواب ملے گا جو مسجد میں اعتکاف کریں اور جنہوں نے کبھی اللہ تعالیٰ کی نافرمانی نہ کی ہو۔ اسی سلسلے میں روایت ہے کہ جو شخص اس رات اللہ تعالیٰ سے کوئی بھی حاجت طلب کرے اللہ تعالیٰ اس کی دعا قبول فرمائے گا۔

تئیس ذی القعدہ: بعض روایات کے مطابق تئیس ذی القعدہ، دو سو ہجری کو امام علی بن موسیٰ رضا علیہ السلام نے وفات پائی۔ لہٰذا اس دن قریب یا دور سے آپ کے روضے کی زیارت کرنا معروف ہے۔ اس بارے میں سید ابن طاؤس اقبال الاعمال میں فرماتے ہیں کہ انہوں نے بعض غیر عرب علماء کی کتاب میں دیکھا ہے کہ تئیس ذی القعدہ کو قریب یا دور سے کسی معروف زیارت یا کسی اور زیارت کے ذریعے امام رضا علیہ السلام کے روضہ مبارک کی زیارت کرنا مستحب ہے۔

A_AB3.name: Night & Day of 25th Dhul Qa'dah (The Spreading of the Earth)

segs.note: Fasting & Worship
segs.ur: روزہ اور عبادت

segs.note: Fast on the twenty-fifth of Dhu’l-Qa’dah, one of the four days on which fasting is exclusively confirmed.
segs.ur: ذی القعدہ کی پچیسویں تاریخ کا روزہ رکھیں، جو ان چار دنوں میں سے ایک ہے جن میں روزہ خاص طور پر ثابت ہے۔

segs.note: Practice acts of worship at this night and on this day, remember Almighty Allah, hold sessions for His remembrance, and bathe.
segs.ur: اس رات اور اس دن عبادت کریں، اللہ تعالیٰ کو یاد کریں، اس کے ذکر کی محفلیں منعقد کریں اور غسل کریں۔

segs.note: Visit the holy tomb of Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Reza (a.s.) on this day (see Ziyarat of Imam Ali al-Reza).
segs.ur: اس دن امام علی بن موسیٰ الرضا (ع) کے مقدس مزار کی زیارت کریں (دیکھیے زیارت امام علی رضا)۔

segs.note: Morning Prayer & Ya Muqil al-Atharat
segs.ur: نماز صبح اور یا مقیل العثرات

segs.note: In the morning, offer a two-unit prayer, reciting in each unit Surah al-Faatehah once and Surah al-Shams five times.
segs.ur: صبح کے وقت دو رکعت نماز پڑھیں، ہر رکعت میں سورہ فاتحہ ایک مرتبہ اور سورہ شمس 5 مرتبہ پڑھیں۔

segs.note: After finishing, recite:
segs.ur: ختم کرنے کے بعد پڑھیں:

segs.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ
segs.en: There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the All-great.
segs.tr: LAA HAWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAHIL A’LIYYIL A’ZEEMO

segs.note: Then pray Almighty Allah for your needs, and recite:
segs.ur: پھر اللہ تعالیٰ سے اپنی حاجتوں کے لیے دعا کریں اور پڑھیں:

segs.en: O He Who overlooks slips, (please) overlook my slip.
O He Who responds to prayers, (please) respond to my prayer.
O He Who hears all sounds, (please) listen to mine,
have mercy on me, and excuse my wrongdoings
segs.tr: WAR HAMNEE WA TAJAAWAZ A’N SAYYE-AATEE

segs.ar: وَمَا عِنْدِيْ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ.
segs.en: and whatever I have committed. O Lord of majesty and honor!
segs.tr: WA MAA I’NDEE YAA ZAL JALAALE WAL IKRAAME.

segs.note: Dua Dahiyal Ka’bah
segs.ur: دعا دحیّ الکعبہ

segs.note: On this day, recite:
segs.ur: اس دن پڑھیں:

segs.en: O Allah Who spread the Ka'bah, split the kernel,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA DAAHE-YAL KA’BATE WA FAALEQAL HABBATE

segs.en: removes troubles, and relieves from all distresses!
segs.tr: WA SAAREFAL LAZBATE WA KAASHEFA KULLE KURBATIN

segs.ar: اَسْاَلُكَ فِىْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ مِنْ اَيَّامِكَ
segs.en: I beseech You on this day, which is one of Your days
segs.tr: AS-ALOKA FEE HAAZAL YAWME MIN AYYAAMEKAL

segs.en: whose standing You have deemed great, whom You have given preference,
segs.tr: LATEE A-A’ZAMTA HAQQAHAA WA AQDAMTA SABQAHAA

segs.en: and whom You have put as trust with the believers
and as means to approaching to You; and [I beseech You] in the name of Your ample mercy
segs.tr: WA ELAYKA ZAREE-A’TAN WA BE-RAHMATEKAL WASEE-A’TE

segs.ar: اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ الْمُنْتَجَبِ
segs.en: to send blessings to Muhammad, Your servant that You have selected
segs.tr: AN TOSALLEYA A’LAA MOHAMMADIN A’BDEKAL MUNTAJABE

segs.en: in the Nigh Covenant on the Meeting Day,

segs.ar: فَاتِقِ كُلِّ رَتْقٍ وَدَاعٍ اِلٰى كُلِّ حَقٍّ
segs.en: the splitter of all joined things and the caller to all truths,
segs.tr: FAATEQE KULLE RATQIN WA DAA-IN ELAA KULLE HAQQIN

segs.en: and to his Household, the pure,
the guides, the lanterns, the pillars of the Omnipotent (Lord),
and the supervisors on Paradise and Hell,
to give us on this day
from Your stored gifts,
gifts that are neither interrupted nor prohibited

segs.ar: تَجْمَعُ لَنَا بِهِ التَّوْبَةَ وَحُسْنَ الْاَوْبَةِ
segs.en: by which You join for us both repentance and acceptable return [to You].
segs.tr: TAJ-MA-O’ LANAA BEHIT TAWBATA WA HUSNAL AWBATE

segs.en: O He Who is the best of all supplicated ones and the most generous of all hoped ones!
segs.tr: YAA KHAYRA MAD-U’WWIN WA AKRAMA MARJUWWIN

segs.ar: يَا كَفِيُّ يَا وَفِيُّ يَا مَنْ لُطْفُهٗ خَفِيٌّ
segs.en: O All-sufficer! O All-true! O He Whose grace is gentle!
segs.tr: YAA KAFIYYO YAA WAFIYYO YAA MAN LUTFOHU KHAFIYYUN

segs.en: (Please) treat me gracefully with Your graciousness, make me feel happy with Your pardon,
segs.tr: ULTUF LEE BE-LUTFEKA WA AS-I’DNEE BE-A’FWEKA

segs.ar: وَاَيِّدْنِيْ بِنَصْرِكَ وَلَا تُنْسِنِيْ كَرِيْمَ ذِكْرِكَ
segs.en: aid me with Your support, never make me inattentive of Your noble mention
segs.tr: WA AYYIDNEE BE-NASREKA WA LAA TUNSENEE KAREEMA ZIKREKA

segs.en: through Your Representatives and the keepers of Your secret,
protect me against the vicissitudes of time
up to the day of resurrection and raising (the dead to life),
and make Your Representatives attend at the hour of the departure of my souls,
segs.tr: WA ASH-HIDNEE AWLEYAA-AKA I’NDA KHOROOJE NAFSEE

segs.ar: وَحُلُوْلِ رَمْسِيْ وَانْقِطَاعِ عَمَلِيْ وَانْقِضَآءِ اَجَلِيْٓ
segs.en: the time of my entry to my grave, when my deed will be interrupted and my lifetime will come to its end.
segs.tr: WA HOLOOLE RAMSEE WAN QETAA-E’ A’MALEE WAN QEZAAA-E AJALEE

segs.en: O Allah, (please) remember me all over the stages of trial
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WAZ KURNEE A’LAA TOOLIL BALAA

segs.en: when I will reside between the layers of the earth
and the forgetful people will forget me.
Allow me to dwell in the abode of eternity,
settle me in the residence of honor,
make me of the companions of Your intimate servants
and the people of Your choice and selection,
bless me by meeting You,
and grant me good doing
before the end of my lifetime,
making me free from slips and foolish doing.
segs.tr: BAREE-AN MENAZ ZALALE WA SOOIL KHATALE

segs.en: O Allah, allow me to enter the Pool of Your Prophet,
Muhammad, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household,
segs.tr: MOHAMMADIN SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WAA AALEHI

segs.en: allow me to drink from it a quenching drink
that is palatable and salubrious

segs.ar: لَآ اَظْمَاُ بَعْدَهٗ وَلَآ اَحْلَاُ وِرْدَهٗ
segs.en: after which I will never be thirsty, I will never be prevented from reaching it,
segs.tr: LAA AZMA-O BA’DAHU WA LAA AHALA-O WIRDAHU

segs.ar: وَلَا عَنْهُ اُذَادُ وَاجْعَلْهُ لِيْ خَيْرَ زَادٍ
segs.en: and I will never be disallowed to approach it. Make for me the best nourishment
segs.tr: WA LAA A’NHO OZAADO WAJ A’LHO LEE KHAYRA ZAADIN

segs.en: and the most fulfilling promise on the day when the Witnesses will rise.
segs.tr: WA AWFAA MEE-A’ADIN YAWMA YAQOOMUL ASH-HAADO

segs.en: O Allah, curse the tyrants from the past and the last generations
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA WAL A’N JABAABERATAL AWWALEENA WAL AAKHEREENA

segs.en: who usurped the dues of Your Representatives.
O Allah, demolish their posts,
annihilate their allies and their assistants,
and hasten their perdition, seize their estates,
segs.tr: WA A’JJIL MAHAALEKAHUM WAS LUBHUM MAMAALEKAHUM

segs.en: make narrow their ways,
and curse their helpers and aides.
Allah, (please) hasten the relief of Your Representatives,
restore to them their usurped rights,
cause their Riser to prevail with the truth,
and make him support Your religion
and carry out Your commandments about Your enemies.
O Allah, make the angels of victory surround him
and so are the commandments that You addressed to him
segs.tr: WA BEMAA ALQAYTA ELAYHE MENAL AMRE

segs.en: at the Destiny Night so that he will punish Your enemies on behalf of You
until You are pleased, Your religion will recover
segs.tr: HATTAA TARZAA WA YA-O’ODA DEENOKA BEHI

segs.en: its freshness and bloom at his hands,

segs.ar: وَيَمْحَضَ الْحَقَّ مَحْضًا وَيَرْفِضَ الْبَاطِلَ رَفْضًا
segs.en: he will clean the truth with thorough cleaning, and he will reject the wrong with absolute rejection.
segs.tr: WA YAMHAZAL HAQQA MAHZAN WA YARFEZAL BAATELA RAFZAN

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى جَمِيْعِ اٰبَآئِهٖ
segs.en: O Allah, send blessings to him and to all of his forefathers,
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAYHE WA A’LAA JAMEE-E’ AABAAA-EHI

segs.en: include us with his companions and group,
segs.tr: WAJ A’LNAA MIN SAHBEHI WA USRATEHI

segs.ar: وَابْعَثْنَا فِيْ كَرَّتِهٖ حَتّٰى نَكُوْنَ فِيْ زَمَانِهٖ مِنْ اَعْوَانِهٖ
segs.en: and resurrect us during his return (raj’at) so that we will live in his age and become of his helpers.
segs.tr: WAB A’SNAA FEE KARRATEHI HATTAA NAKOONA FEE ZAMAANEHI MIN A-A’WAANEHI

segs.en: O Allah, make us catch up his advent,
make us witness his days, bless him,
segs.tr: WA ASHIDNAA AYYAAMAHU WA SALLE A’LAYHE (A’LAA MOHAMMADIN)

segs.en: and convey to us his greetings.
Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon him.
segs.tr: WAS SALAAMO A’LAYHE (A’LAYHIM) WA RAHMATUL LAAHE WA BARAKAATOHU.

A_AB3.merits:
The night: This night is called laylat dahw al-arz (the night at which the earth was spread on the water where the Holy Ka’bah is now situated). Being distinctively honorable, at this night the mercy of Almighty Allah is poured on people. A great reward is obtained by those who practice acts of worship at this night.

Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Washsha’ has narrated that when he was young, he was with his father in the hospitality of Imam al-Reza (a.s.) at the twenty-fifth night of Dhu’l-Qa’dah. After they had their supper, Imam al-Reza (a.s.) said, “At the twenty-fifth night of Dhu’l-Qa’dah, Prophet Ibrahim (a.s.) was born, Prophet Eesaa (a.s.) the son of Mary was born, and the earth was spread on the water where the Holy Ka’bah is now situated. Hence, if one observes fasting on this day, he will be given the reward of observing fasting in sixth months.” According to another narration, Imam al-Reza (a.s.) added, “Verily, on this day, al-Qa’im (i.e. Imam al-Mahdi) (a.t.f.s.) will appear.”

The day: The twenty-fifth of Zilqad is one of the four days on which fasting is exclusively confirmed. According to a narration, to observe fasting on this day is equal to seventy year fasting. It also erases the sins of seventy years. According to another narration, to observe fasting on this day and to practice acts of worship at its night is equal (in reward) to one hundred year worship. Everything that is between the sky and the earth will ask God’s forgiveness for one who does these rites. On this day, the mercy of Almighty Allah has been spread. To practice acts of worship and hold sessions for mentioning Almighty Allah on this day bring about an abundant reward.

Morning prayer and Ya Muqil al-Atharat: this is mentioned in the books written by Shi’ite scholars of Qumm.

Dua Dahiyal Ka’bah: In Misbah al-Mutahajjid, Shaykh al-Tusi has mentioned that it is recommended to say this supplicatory prayer on this day.

Visiting Imam al-Reza (a.s.): In his epistle entitled al-Arba’at Ayyam (The Four Days), Sayyid al-Damad has mentioned that to visit the holy tomb of Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Reza (a.s.) on the day; i.e. the Earth Spreading Day, is the most preferable act. Similarly, to visit his tomb on the first of Rajab is highly desirable; therefore, he has urged on it greatly.
A_AB3.meritsUr:
رات: اس رات کو لیلۃ دحو الارض کہا جاتا ہے (یعنی وہ رات جس میں زمین اس جگہ سے پانی پر پھیلائی گئی جہاں آج خانہ کعبہ ہے)۔ یہ رات خاص عزت والی ہے، اس رات لوگوں پر اللہ تعالیٰ کی رحمت نازل ہوتی ہے۔ جو لوگ اس رات عبادت کریں انہیں بہت بڑا ثواب ملتا ہے۔

علی بن حسن وشاء نے روایت کی ہے کہ جب وہ کم سن تھے تو ذی القعدہ کی پچیسویں رات اپنے والد کے ساتھ امام رضا علیہ السلام کے مہمان تھے۔ رات کا کھانا کھانے کے بعد امام رضا علیہ السلام نے فرمایا: ”ذی القعدہ کی پچیسویں رات حضرت ابراہیم علیہ السلام پیدا ہوئے، حضرت عیسیٰ بن مریم علیہ السلام پیدا ہوئے، اور زمین اس جگہ سے پانی پر پھیلائی گئی جہاں آج خانہ کعبہ ہے۔ لہٰذا جو شخص اس دن روزہ رکھے اسے ساٹھ مہینوں کے روزوں کا ثواب ملے گا۔“ ایک اور روایت کے مطابق امام رضا علیہ السلام نے مزید فرمایا: ”یقیناً اسی دن حضرت قائم (یعنی امام مہدی) عجل اللہ تعالیٰ فرجہ الشریف ظہور فرمائیں گے۔“

دن: پچیس ذی القعدہ ان چار دنوں میں سے ہے جن میں روزہ رکھنے کی خاص تاکید کی گئی ہے۔ ایک روایت کے مطابق اس دن روزہ رکھنا ستر سال کے روزوں کے برابر ہے۔ یہ ستر سال کے گناہ بھی مٹا دیتا ہے۔ ایک اور روایت کے مطابق اس دن روزہ رکھنا اور اس کی رات عبادت کرنا (ثواب میں) سو سال کی عبادت کے برابر ہے۔ جو شخص یہ اعمال انجام دے، زمین و آسمان کے درمیان کی ہر چیز اس کے لیے اللہ سے مغفرت طلب کرتی ہے۔ اس دن اللہ تعالیٰ کی رحمت پھیلائی گئی ہے۔ اس دن عبادت کرنا اور ذکر الٰہی کی مجالس منعقد کرنا بہت زیادہ ثواب کا باعث ہے۔

صبح کی نماز اور یا مقیل العثرات: یہ قم کے شیعہ علماء کی لکھی ہوئی کتابوں میں مذکور ہے۔

دعائے داحی الکعبہ: مصباح المتہجد میں شیخ طوسی نے ذکر کیا ہے کہ اس دن یہ دعا پڑھنا مستحب ہے۔

زیارت امام رضا علیہ السلام: سید داماد نے اپنے رسالے الاربعۃ ایام (چار دن) میں ذکر کیا ہے کہ اس دن، یعنی دحو الارض کے دن، امام علی بن موسیٰ رضا علیہ السلام کے روضہ مبارک کی زیارت سب سے افضل عمل ہے۔ اسی طرح پہلی رجب کو آپ کی زیارت بھی بہت پسندیدہ ہے؛ لہٰذا انہوں نے اس کی بہت تاکید کی ہے۔

A_AC1.name: Ziyarat on the Day of Ghadir

segs.note: With the intention of visiting the holy tomb of Imam Ali (a.s.), you may stop at the gate of the dome of the holy shrine and seek permission of entrance. Shaykh al-Mufeed says that you may wash yourself, put on the cleanest of your clothes, and say this form of seeking permission, which begins:
segs.ur: امام علی (ع) کی مبارک قبر کی زیارت کی نیت سے آپ روضۂ مقدس کے گنبد کے دروازے پر رک کر اندر داخل ہونے کی اجازت طلب کر سکتے ہیں۔ شیخ مفید فرماتے ہیں کہ آپ غسل کریں، اپنے سب سے صاف کپڑے پہنیں اور اجازت طلب کرنے کے یہ الفاظ کہیں جو یوں شروع ہوتے ہیں:

segs.en: O Allah, indeed I have stood at a door...

segs.note: You may then enter there with your right foot and walk until you stop at the holy tomb, which you may face and make the kiblah direction to be between your shoulders. There, you may say:
segs.ur: پھر دائیں پاؤں سے داخل ہوں اور چلیں یہاں تک کہ روضۂ مقدس کے پاس رک جائیں، اس کی طرف رخ کریں اور قبلہ کو اپنے دونوں کندھوں کے درمیان رکھیں۔ وہاں کہیں:

segs.en: Peace be on Mohammad, the Apostle of Allah,
the Last of the Prophets and the leader of the Apostles
and the chosen one of the Lord of the Universe, the trustee of Allah
segs.tr: WA SAFWATE RABBIL A’ALAMEENA AMEENIL LAAHE

segs.en: upon His revelation and His intentions and the last
segs.tr: A’LAA WAHYEHI WA A’ZAAEME AMREHI WAL KHAATEME

segs.en: of those who preceded him and the beginner for all
segs.tr: LEMAA SABAQA WAL FAATEHE LEMAS TUQBELA

segs.en: those who will come in the future and he is the guardian over all that
and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings and His Salutations and His Greetings.
segs.tr: WA RAHMATULLAAHE WA BARAKAATOHU WA SALAWAATOHU WATAHIYYAATOHU

segs.en: Peace be on the Prophet of Allah and His Apostles
and His proximate angels and His righteous servants.
segs.tr: WA MALAAAEKATEHIL MOQARRABEENA WA E’BAADEHIS SAALEHEENA

segs.en: Peace be on you, O the leader of the faithful
and the chief of the vicegerents and the inheritor of the knowledge
of the Prophets and the representative of the Lord of the Universe
and my master and the master of the believers
segs.tr: WA MAULAAYA WA MAULAL AL MUMINEEN

segs.en: and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings be on you.

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا اَمِيْرَ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O my master, O the leader
segs.tr: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKA YA MAULAAYA YAA AMEERAL

segs.ar: الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ يَا اَمِيْنَ اللهِ فِيْ اَرْضِهٖ
segs.en: of the faithful, O the trustee of Allah in His earth

segs.ar: وَسَفِيْرَهٗ فِيْ خَلْقِهٖ وَحُجَّتَهُ الْبَالِغَةَ عَلٰي عِبَادِهٖ
segs.en: and His envoy among His creation and His conclusive argument upon His servants.
segs.tr: WA SAFEERAHU FEE KHALQEHI WA HUJJATUL BAALEGHATA A’LAA EBAADEHI

segs.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا دِيْنَ اللهِ الْقَوِيْمَ
segs.en: Peace be on you, O the upright religion of Allah
and His straight path.
Peace be on you, O the great news concerning

segs.ar: الَّذِيْ هُمْ فِيْهِ مُخْتَلِفُوْنَ وَعَنْهُ يُسْئَلُوْنَ
segs.en: whom they differ and about whom they will be questioned.
segs.tr: LAZEE HUM FEEHE MUKHTALEFOONA WA A’NHO YUS-ALOONA

segs.en: Peace be on you, O the chief of the faithful,
you believed in Allah while they were polytheists
and you testified to the truth while they were the deniers
and you strove and fought (in the way of Allah) while they expressed cowardice.

segs.ar: وَعَبَدْتَ اللهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّيْنَ صَابِرًا
segs.en: And you worshipped Allah sincerely, exuberating patience
segs.tr: WA A’BADTALLAAHA MUKHLESAN LAHUD DEENA SAABERAN

segs.en: and forbearance till the time death overtook you.
Behold! Curse of Allah be upon the oppressors.
Peace be on you, O the chief of the submitters
and the commander of the believers and the leader
of the pious and the guide of those with radiant foreheads
and the mercy of Allah and His Blessings.

segs.ar: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ اَخُوْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ وَوَصِيُّهٗ
segs.en: I bear witness that you are the brother of Apostle of Allah and his vicegerent
segs.tr: ASH-HADO ANNAKA AKHOO RASOOLILLAAHE WA WASIYYOHU

segs.en: and the inheritor of his knowledge and his trustee on
segs.tr: WA WAARESO I’LMEHI WA AMEENOHU A’LAA

segs.ar: شَرْعِهٖ وَخَلِيْفَتُهٗ فِيْ اُمَّتِهٖ وَاَوَّلَ مَنْ
segs.en: his laws and his caliph upon his nation and the first of
segs.tr: SHAR-E’HI WA KHALEEFATOHU FEE UMMATEHI WA AWWALO MAN

segs.ar: اٰمَنَ بِاللهِ وَصَدَّقَ بِمَآ اُنْزِلَ عَلٰي نَبِيِّهٖ
segs.en: those who believe in Allah and to testify in whatever has been sent upon His Prophet
segs.tr: AAMANA BILLAAHE WA SADDAQA BEMA UNZELA A’LAA NABIYYEHI

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّهٗ قَدْ بَلَّغَ عَنِ اللهِ مَا
segs.en: and I bear witness that surely he (Holy Prophet) conveyed all that was
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAHU QAD BALLAGHA A’NILLAAHE MAA

segs.en: revealed concerning you from the side of Allah and complied with His commands
segs.tr: ANZALAHU FEEKA WA SADA-A’ BE AMREHI

segs.en: and made obligatory upon his nation your obedience
segs.tr: WA AWJABA A’LAA UMMATEHI FARZA TAA-A’TEKA

segs.en: and your mastership and he took your pledge of allegiance from them
segs.tr: WA WELAAYATEKA WA A’QADA A’LAYHEMUL BAYATA LAKA

segs.en: and he declared you to having more authority over the believers than
segs.tr: WA JA-A’LAKA AWLAA BIL MOMINEENA MIN

segs.en: they have over their own selves just as Allah has made him such.

segs.ar: ثُمَّ اَشْهَدَ اللهَ تَعَالٰي عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ
segs.en: Then he made Allah as a witness upon them and then said,

segs.ar: اَلَسْتُ قَدْ بَلَّغْتُ فَقَالُوْا اللّٰهُمَّ بَلٰي
segs.en: ‘Is it not that I have conveyed?’ They replied, ‘Yes, by Allah.’
segs.tr: ALASTO QAD BALLAGHTO FAQAALUL LAAHUMMA BALAA

segs.en: Then he said, ‘O Allah! You be a witness and You are sufficient as
segs.tr: FAQAALA ALLAAHUMMASH HAD WA KAFAA BEKA

segs.en: a witness and a judge between the servants.

segs.ar: فَلَعَنَ اللهُ جَاحِدَ وِلَايَتِكَ بَعْدَ الْاِقْرَارِ
segs.en: Then may Allah curse those who rejected your mastership after having attested to it
segs.tr: FA LA-A’NALLAAHO JAAHEDA WELAAYATEKA BA’DAL IQRAARE

segs.en: and they broke your promise after having made the covenant.

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ وَفَيْتَ بِعَهْدِ اللهِ تَعَالٰي
segs.en: And I bear witness that you fulfilled the covenant of Allah, the High,
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKA WAFAYTA BE A’HDILLAAHE TA-A’ALAA

segs.ar: وَاَنَّ اللهَ تَعَالٰي مُوفٍ لَكَ بِعَهْدِهٖ
segs.en: and that Allah will redeem His Promise to you and one who observed
segs.tr: WA ANNALLAAHA TA-A’ALAA MOOFIN LAKA BE A’HDEHI

segs.ar: وَمَنْ اَوْفٰي بِمَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهُ اللهُ
segs.en: whatever he had promised to Allah,
segs.tr: WA MAN AWFAA BEMAA A’AHADA A’LAYHULLAAHO

segs.en: then surely Allah will grant him a great reward.
And I bear witness that you are the leader of the faithful truly,
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKA AMEERUL MOMINEENAL HAQQO

segs.en: the Revelation (Quran) speaks eloquently about your mastership

segs.ar: وَاَخَذَ لَكَ الْعَهْدَ عَلَي الْاُمَّةِ بِذٰلِكَ
segs.en: and the Apostle took a covenant to this effect
segs.tr: WA AKHAZA LAKAL A’HDA A’LAL UMMATEHI BEZAALEKAR

segs.en: from his nation and I bear witness that you and your uncle
segs.tr: RASOOLO WA ASH-HADO ANNAKA WA A’MMAKA

segs.en: and your brother have all traded

segs.ar: بِنُفُوسِكُمْ فَاَنْزَلَ اللهُ فِيْكُمْ اِنَّ اللهَ
segs.en: their lives with Allah. Then Allah has revealed about you. "Surely Allah
has bought from the believers their lives
and their wealth in lieu of Paradise, they fight in the way of Allah
segs.tr: WA AMWAALAHUM BE ANNA LAHOMUL JANNATA YOQAATELOONA

segs.en: and they kill and are killed,
Allah’s Promise is true which is mentioned in the Torah,
the Bible and the Holy Quran and whoever fulfills
segs.tr: WAL INJEELE WAL QUR-AANE WA MAN AWFAA

segs.en: his covenant with Allah then give him glad tidings of your trading
segs.tr: BE A’HDEHI MENALLAAHE FASTABASHERU BE BAY-E’KOMUL

segs.ar: الَّذِيْ بَايَعْتُمْ بِهٖ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ
segs.en: of what you have traded and that is a great
segs.tr: LAZEE BAAYA’TUM BEHI WA ZAALEKA HOWAL FAWZUL

segs.en: success. The repentants, the worshippers,
the glorifiers, those who observe fast, those who bow,
those who prostrate, those who enjoin good
and forbid evil and those who observe
the limits set by Allah and give glad tidings to the believers."

segs.ar: اَشْهَدُ يَا اَمِيْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ اَنَّ الشَّآكَ
segs.en: I bear witness, O leader of the faithful, that he
segs.tr: ASH-HADO YA AMEERAL MOMINEENA ANNASH SHAAKKA

segs.ar: فِيْكَ مَا اٰمَنَ بِالرَّسُوْلِ الْاَمِيْنِ وَاَنَّ
segs.en: does not believe in the trustworthy Apostle who has
segs.tr: FEEKA MAA AAMANA BIR RASOOLIL AMEENE WA ANNAL

segs.ar: الْعَادِلَ بِكَ غَيْرِكَ عَانِدٌ عَنِ الدِّيْنِ
segs.en: scepticism concerning you that is an enemy of the upright
segs.tr: AADELA BEKA GHAIRAKA A’ANEDUN A’NID DEENIL

segs.en: religion who has equated someone else with you, the religion with which the Lord
of the universe has chosen for us and which He has perfected by your mastership on the
segs.tr: A’ALAMEENA WA AKMALAHU BE WELAAYATEKA YAWMAL

segs.en: Day of Ghadeer and I bear witness that you are the one meant in the following verse
segs.tr: GHADEERE WA ASH-HADO ANNAKAL MA’NIYYO BEQAWLIL

segs.en: of the Honoured the Merciful (Allah): And that this is My straight path,
segs.tr: A’ZEEZIR RAHEEME WA ANNA HAAZA SERAATI

segs.en: then follow it and do not follow other paths
segs.tr: MUSTAQEEMAN FATTABE-O’O-HO WA LAA TATTABE-O’OS SOBOLA

segs.ar: فَتَفَرَّقَ بِكُمْ عَنْ سَبِيْلِهٖ ضَلَّ وَاللهِ
segs.en: then it will deviate you from the path of Allah. I swear by Allah
segs.tr: FA TAFRRAQA BEKUM A’N SABEELEHI ZALLA WAL LAAHE

segs.ar: وَاَضَلَّ مَنِ التَّبَعَ سِوَاكَ وَعِنْدَ عَنِ
segs.en: that he is deviated and hedeviates others who follows anybody other than you, and that he is an enemy
segs.tr: WA AZALLA MANIT TABA-A’ SEWAAKA WA I’NDA A’NIL

segs.en: of the truth who opposes you.
O Allah! we have heard your command and we have obeyed and we have followed
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA SAMEA’NAA LE AMREKA WA ATA’NAA WAT TABA’NAA

segs.en: your straight path, then O our Lord, do guide us and

segs.ar: تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ اِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا اِلٰي
segs.en: do not deviate our hearts after you have guided us
segs.tr: TOZIGH QOLOOBANAA BA’DA IZ HADAYTANAA ELAA

segs.en: towards Your obedience. And include us from those who are thankful for Your bounties,

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ لَمْ تَزَلْ لِلْهَوٰي مُخَالِفًا
segs.en: and I bear witness that You always opposed vain
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKA LAM TAZAL LILHAWAA MOKHAALEFAN

segs.en: entertainment and you always exhorted piety
segs.tr: WA LIT-TOQAA MOHAALEFAN WA A’LAA KAZ-MIL GHAYZE

segs.ar: قَادِرًا وَعَنِ النَّاسِ عَافِيًا غَافِرًا وَاِذَا
segs.en: and you were able to curb the anger and you were forgiving towards the people
segs.tr: QAADERAN WA A’NIN NAASE A’AFEYAN GHAAFERAN WA EZAA

segs.ar: عُصِيَ اللهُ سَاخِطًا وَاِذَا اُطِيْعَ اللهُ
segs.en: and you were angry whenever Allah is disobeyed and

segs.ar: رَاضِيًا وَبِمَا عَهِدَ اِلَيْكَ عَامِلًا رَاعِيًا
segs.en: you were satisfied whenever Allah was obeyed and you acted upon
segs.tr: RAAZEYAN WA BEMAA A’HEDA ELAYKA A’AMELAN RAA-E’YAN

segs.en: the covenant of Allah and observed it and you protected the trust when

segs.ar: اسْتُودِعْتَ مُبَلِّغًا مَا حُمِّلْتَ مُنْتَظِرًا مَا وُعِدْتَ
segs.en: it was deposited with you and you conveyed whatever was entrusted to you. And you awaited what was promised to you.
segs.tr: TOODE’TA MOBALLEGHAN MAA HUMMILTA MUNTAZERAN MAA WO-ID-TA

segs.ar: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ مَا اتَّقَيْتَ ضَارِعًا وَلَا
segs.en: And I bear witness that you did not fear (your enemy) due to disgrace and
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKA MATTAQAYTO ZAARE-A’N WALAA

segs.en: neither did you desist from your right out of helplessness
nor did you avoid fighting against the usurpers out of cowardice
nor did you express satisfaction in contrary to

segs.ar: مَا يُرْضِي اللهَ مُدَاهِنًا وَلَا وَهَنْتَ لِمَا
segs.en: what Allah is satisfied with out of flattery and you did not become disgraced or weak on account of
segs.tr: MAA YURZILLAAHA MODAAHENAN WALAA WAHANTA LEMAA

segs.ar: اَصَابَكَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللهِ وَلَا ضَعُفْتَ
segs.en: the tribulations that afflicted you in the way of Allah and
neither did you observe weakness or slackness in the seeking of your right out of fear.

segs.ar: مُرَاقِبًا مَعَاذَ اللهِ اَنْ تَكُوْنَ كَذٰلِكَ
segs.en: I seek protection in Allah that it be like that. Rather, it was like this
that whenever you were oppressed, you took into account (the satisfaction of) your Lord
and you entrusted your affair to Him and you adviced them but they
segs.tr: WA FAWWAZTA ELAYHE AMRAKA WA ZAKKARTAHUM FAMAZ

segs.en: ignored it and you admonished them but they did not pay heed to it and
you tried to imbibe fear of Allah in them but they remain unaffected
and I bear witness that you, O the commander of the faithful,
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKA YA AMEERAL MOMINEENA

segs.ar: جَاهَدْتَ فِيْ اللهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهٖ حَتّٰي
segs.en: you fought in the way of Allah as it ought to be

segs.ar: دَعَاكَ اللهُ اِلٰي جِوَارِهٖ وَقَبَضَكَ اِلَيْهِ
segs.en: till the time Allah called you in His precints and He
segs.tr: DA-A’AKALLAAHO ELAA JEWAAREHI WA QABAZAKA ILAYHE

segs.en: captured your soul by His choice and made incumbent His argument
segs.tr: BE IKHTEYAAREHI WA ALZAMA A’ADAAA-EKAL HUJJATA

segs.en: against your enemies by their killing you
segs.tr: BE QATLEHIM IYYAAKA LE TAKOONAL HUJJATO LAKA

segs.ar: عَلَيْهِمْ مَعَ مَا لَكَ مِنَ الْحُجَجِ
segs.en: so that it can be an argument for you against
them from the decisive arguments upon all the creation.
Peace be on you, O the commander of the faithful,
you worshipped Allah sincerely and fought in the
way of Allah with patience and sacrificed your life
by the order of Allah and you acted upon His Book and followed the
segs.tr: MOHTASEBAN WA A’MILTA BE KETAABEHI WATTABA’TA

segs.en: traditions of His Prophet and you established the prayer and gave
segs.tr: SUNNATA NABIYYEHI WA AQAMTAS SALAATA WA AATAYTAZ

segs.en: the poor-due and enjoined the good
and forbade the evil as much as you could and you sought the
segs.tr: WA NAHAYTA A’NIL MUNKARE MAS TATA’TA

segs.ar: مُبْتَغِيًا مَا عِنْدَ اللهِ رَاغِبًا فِيْمَا وَعَدَ
segs.en: satisfaction of Allah and you yearned for the Promise
segs.tr: MUBTAGHEYAN MA I’NDALLAAHE RAAGHEBAN FEEMAA WA-A’DAL

segs.ar: اللهُ لَا تَحْفِلُ بِالنَّوَآئِبِ وَلَا تَهِنُ
segs.en: of Allah.You did not express cowardice in the
segs.tr: LAAHO LAA TAHFELO BINNAWAAA-EBE WALAA TAHENO

segs.en: face of difficulties neither did you feel disgrace in tribulation nor did you make a retreat

segs.ar: مُحَارِبٍ اَفَكَ مَنْ نَسَبَ غَيْرَ ذٰلِكَ
segs.en: from any battle. Anyone who says contrary to this has certainly lied and has
segs.tr: MOHAAREBIN AFAKA MAN NASABA GHAYRA ZAALEKA

segs.en: ascribed falsehood to you and he certainly perished who intentionally opposed you.
segs.tr: ELAYKA WAFTARAA BAATELAN A’LAYKA WA AWLAA

segs.ar: لِمَنْ عِنْدَ عَنْكَ لَقَدْ جَاهَدْتَ فِي اللهِ
segs.en: Certainly you fought in the way of Allah
segs.tr: LEMAN I’NDA A’NKA LAQAD JAAHADTA FEELLAAHE

segs.en: as it ought to be and you exhibited the patience
segs.tr: HAQQAL JEHAADE WA SABARTA A’LAL AZAA

segs.ar: صَبْرَ احْتِسَابٍ وَاَنْتَ اَوَّلُ مَنْ اٰمَنَ
segs.en: of an expectant person in the face of troubles and tortures while you were the first to believe
segs.tr: SABRAH TESAABIN WA ANTA AWWALO MAN AAMANA

segs.en: in Allah and pray to Him and fight in His way. You manifested openly
segs.tr: BILLAAHE WA SALLAA LAHU WA JAAHADA WA ABADAA

segs.en: in the land of polytheism while the earth
segs.tr: SAFHATAHU FEE DAARISH SHIRKE WAL ARZO

segs.en: was full of deviation and the Devil was worshipped
segs.tr: MASH HOONATUN ZALAALATAN WASH SHAYTAANO YO’BADO

segs.en: openly and you used to say that the multitude
segs.tr: JAH-RATAN WA ANTAL QAAA-ELO LAA TAZEEDONEE

segs.ar: كَثْرَةُ النَّاسِ حَوْلِيْ عِزَّةً وَلَا تَفَرُّقُهُمْ
segs.en: of people around me will not increase my honour nor will their dispersion from me
segs.tr: KASRATUN NAASE HAWLEE I’ZZATAN WALAA TAFARROQOHUM

segs.en: cause me forloneness and if all the people would have submitted to me,
segs.tr: A’NNEE WAHSHATAN WA LAW ASLAMANIN NAASO

segs.en: I would not become humble (to them) You have clung
unto Allah then He has granted you honour and you preferred the hereafter to this world
segs.tr: BILLAAHE FA A’ZAZTA WA AASARTAL AAKHERATA

segs.en: so you exhibited abstinence and Allah assisted you
and guided you and made you devoted and chose you,
segs.tr: WA HADAAKA WA AKHLASAKA WAJ TABAAKA

segs.en: thus there was no discrepancy in your actions and no contradiction
in your sayings and no alteration in your conditions.

segs.ar: ادَّعَيْتَ وَلَا افْتَرَيْتَ عَلَي اللهِ كَذِبًا
segs.en: You did not claim nor lied against Allah
and were not greedy for the wealth of this world and neither

segs.ar: دَنَّسَكَ الْاٰثَامُ وَلَمْ تَزَلْ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ
segs.en: did sins pollute you and you always remained on the Proof
segs.tr: DANNASAKAL AASAAMO WALAM TAZAL A’LAA BAYYENATIN

segs.ar: مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَيَقِيْنٍ مِنْ اَمْرِكَ تَهْدِيْ
segs.en: from your Lord and certitude regarding your affair.
segs.tr: MIN RABBEKA WA YAQEENIN MIN AMREKA TAHDEE

segs.en: You guided towards the truth and the straight path.
segs.tr: ELAL HAQQE WA ELAA SERAATIN MUSTAQEEMIN

segs.en: I bear witness, a rightful witnessing, and a swear by Allah
segs.tr: ASH-HADO SAHAADATA HAQQIN WA UKSEMO BILLAAHE

segs.en: with a true swear that Mohammad and his progeny
segs.tr: QASAMA SIDQIN ANNA MOHAMMADIN WA AALAHU

segs.en: are the leaders of the creation
and that you are my master and the master of the believers
segs.tr: WA ANNAKA MAWLAAYA WA MAWLAL MOMINEENA

segs.en: and that you are the servant of Allah and His friend and the brother
segs.tr: WA ANNAKA A’BDULLAAHE WA WALLIYYOHU WA AKHUR

segs.en: of the Apostle and his vicegerent and his inheritor and that he
segs.tr: RASOOLE WA WASEEYOHU WA WAARESOHU WA ANNAHUL

segs.ar: الْقَآئِلُ لَكَ وَالَّذِيْ بَعَثَنِيْ بِالْحَقِّ مَا
segs.en: said to you:I swear by the
segs.tr: QAAA-ELO LAKA WALLAZEE BA-A’SANEE BIL HAQQE MAA

segs.ar: اٰمَنَ بِيْ مَنْ كَفَرَ بِكَ وَلَا اَقَرَّ
segs.en: One Who has raised me with the truth, he does not believe in me who denies you and he does not affirm
segs.tr: AAMANA BEE MAN KAFARA BEKA WALAA AQARRA

segs.ar: بِاللهِ مَنْ جَحَدَكَ وَقَدْ ضَلَّ مَنْ
segs.en: in Allah who rejects you and certainly he is deviated
segs.tr: BILLAAHE MAN JAHADAKA WAQAD ZALLA MAN

segs.ar: صَدَّ عَنْكَ وَلَمْ يَهْتَدِ اِلَي اللهِ وَلَا
segs.en: who digresses from you and he is not guided towards Allah and towards
segs.tr: SADDA A’NKA WALAM YAHTADE ILALLAAHE WALAA

segs.ar: اِلَيَّ مَنْ لَا يَهْتَدِيْ بِكَ وَهُوَ قَوْلُ
segs.en: me who is not guided towards you and this is the saying of
segs.tr: ELLAYYA MAN LAAYAHTADEE BEKA WA HOWA QAWLO

segs.ar: رَبِّيْ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَاِنِّيْ لَغَفَّارٌ لِمَنْ تَابَ
segs.en: my Lord, the Honoured, the Majestic. "And surely I forgive
segs.tr: RABBEE A’ZZAWAJALLA WA INNEE LAGHAFFAARUN LEMAN TAABA

segs.en: those who repent and believe and do good and then he is guided"
segs.tr: WA AAMANA WA A’MELA SAALEHAN SUMMAH TADAA

segs.en: towards your mastership. O my master, your excellence

segs.ar: يَخْفٰي وَنُوْرُكَ لَا يُطْفَأُ وَاَنَّ مَنْ
segs.en: cannot be concealed and your light cannot be extinguished and the one
segs.tr: YAKHFAA WA NOOROKA LAA YUTFA-O WA ANNA MAN

segs.en: who denies you is an excessive oppressor and the most unfortunate one.
O my master, you are the proof upon the servants and the guide
towards the right course and the support concerning the hereafter.
segs.tr: WAL HAADEE ELAR RASHAADE WAL U’DDATO LIL MA-A’ADE

segs.ar: مَوْلَايَ لَقَدْ رَفَعَ اللهُ فِي الْاُولٰي
segs.en: O my master, surely Allah has raised your status in this world
and has elevated your grade in the hereafter and has

segs.ar: دَرَجَتَكَ وَبَصَّرَكَ مَا عَمِيَ عَلٰي مَنْ
segs.en: made you see what your enemies are blind
segs.tr: DARAJATAKA WA BASSARAKA MA A’MEYA A’LAA MAN

segs.en: to and came between you and the bounties of Allah
segs.tr: KHAALAFAKA WA HAALA BAYNAKA WA BAYNA MAWAAHEBIL

segs.ar: اللهِ لَكَ فَلَعَنَ اللهُ مُسْتَحِلِّيْ الْحُرْمَةِ
segs.en: for you. Then may Allah curse those who misappropriated your honour
segs.tr: LAAHE LAKA FA LA’NALLAAHO MUSTAHILLIL HURMATE

segs.en: and distanced your right from you
and I bear witness that they

segs.ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوْهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيْهَا كَالِحُوْنَ
segs.en: are the most severe losers, those whose faces will be scorched in Hell-fire and they will gloomily abide therein.
segs.tr: TALFAHO WOJOOHAHOMUN NAARO WA HUM FEEHA KAALEHOONA

segs.en: And I bear witness that you did not make
segs.tr: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKA MAA AQDAMTA WALAA

segs.en: any endeavour or desisted from anything nor said anything or withheld anything

segs.ar: اِلَّا بِاَمْرٍ مِنَ اللهِ وَرَسُوْلِهٖ قُلْتَ
segs.en: except by the order of Allah and His Apostle. You said:
segs.tr: ILLAA BE AMRIN MENALLAAHE WA RASOOLEHI QULTA

segs.ar: وَالَّذِيْ نَفْسِيْ بِيَدِهٖ لَقَدْ نَظَرَ اِلَيَّ
segs.en: "I swear by the One in Whose hand is my soul
segs.tr: WAL LAZEE NAFSEE BEYADEHI LAQAD NAZARA ILAYYA

segs.ar: رَسُوْلُ اللهِ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ
segs.en: that the Apostle of Allah; peace be upon him and his family ,

segs.ar: اَضْرِبُ السَّيْفَ قُدْمًا فَقَالَ يَا عَلِيُّ
segs.en: was looking at me when I was fighting with the sword in front of him. ‘O Ali!
segs.tr: AZREBO BISSAYFA QUDMAN FAQAALA YAA A’LIYYO

segs.ar: اَنْتَ مِنِّيْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُوْنَ مِنْ مُوْسٰي
segs.en: You are to me as Haroon was to Moosa
segs.tr: ANTA MINNEE BE MANZELATEHI HAAROONA MIN MOOSA

segs.ar: اِلَّا اَنَّهٗ لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدِيْ وَاُعْلِمُكَ اَنَّ
segs.en: except that there is no Prophet after me and I inform you that
segs.tr: ILLAA ANNAHU LAA NABIYYA BA’DEE WA O’LEMOKA ANNA

segs.en: your death and your life is with me and on my tradition,
segs.tr: MAWTAKA WA HAYAATAKA MA-E’E WA A’LAA SUNNATEE

segs.ar: فَوَ اللهِ مَا كَذِبْتُ وَلَا كُذِبْتُ وَلَا
segs.en: then by Allah, I have never lied nor have even been lied to and neither
segs.tr: FAWALLAAHE MAA KAZIBTO WALAA KOZIBTO WALAA

segs.ar: ضَلَلْتُ وَلَا ضُلَّ بِيْ وَلَا نَسِيْتُ مَا
segs.en: have I been deviated nor has anyone been deviated by me and neither have I forgotten
segs.tr: ZALALTO WALAA ZULLA BEE WALAA NASAYTO MAA

segs.ar: عَهِدَ اِلَيَّ رَبِّيْ وَاِنِّيْ لَعَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ
segs.en: what my Lord has taken as covenant from me and I am on a proof from
segs.tr: A’HEDA ELAYYA RABBEE WA INNEE LA-A’LAA BAYYENATIN MIN

segs.ar: رَبِّيْ بَيَّنَهَا لِنَبِيِّهٖ وَبَيَّنَهَا النَّبِيُّ لِيْ
segs.en: my Lord which He has explained to His Prophet and the Prophet has in turn explained to me
segs.tr: RABBEE BAYYANAHAA LENABIYYEHI WA BAYYANAHAN NABIYYO LEE

segs.en: and surely I am on a clear path which
I articulate to you. I swear by Allah! You have spoken the truth and have said correctly.
segs.tr: LAFZAN SADAQTA WALLAAHE WA QULTAL HAQQA

segs.ar: فَلَعَنَ اللهُ مَنْ سَاوَاكَ بِمَنْ نَاوَاكَ
segs.en: Then may Allah curse those who equate your enemies with you
segs.tr: FA LA’NALLAAHO MAN SAAWAAKA BEMAN NAAWAAKA

segs.ar: وَاللهُ جَلَّ اسْمُهٗ يَقُوْلُ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي
segs.en: while Allah, Honoured be His name, has said: Are those
segs.tr: WALLAAHO JALLAS MOHU YAQOOLO HAL YASTAWIL

segs.en: who know equal to those who don’t?
segs.tr: LAZEENA YA’LAMOONA WAL LAZEENA LAA YA’LAMOONA

segs.ar: فَلَعَنَ اللهُ مَنْ عَدَلَ بِكَ مَنْ فَرَضَ
segs.en: Then curse of Allah be upon the one who has equated with you the one on whom
segs.tr: FA LA’NAL LAAHO MAN A’DALA BEKA MAN FARAZAL

segs.ar: اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وِلَايَتَكَ وَاَنْتَ وَلِيُّ اللهِ
segs.en: your mastership has been made obligatory and you are the friend of Allah
segs.tr: LAAHO A’LAYHE WELAAYATAKA WA ANTA WALIYUL LAAHE

segs.en: and the brother of His Apostle and the defender of His religion
segs.tr: WA AKHOO RASOOLEHI WAZ-ZAAAB-BO A’N DEENEHI

segs.en: and the one whose virtues have been extolled by the Quran.
segs.tr: WAL LAZEE NATAQAL QUR-AANO BE TAFZEELEHI

segs.en: Allah, the High, has said. "And Allah has excelled the warriors
over the sitting ones with a great
reward and grades, forgiveness and
mercy from His side and Allah is forgiving, merciful
segs.tr: WA RAHMATAN WA KAANALLAAHO GHAFOORAN RAHEEMAN

segs.en: and Allah, the Elevated, has said: Do you consider the one who provides
water to the pilgrims and the one who constructs the Sacred Mosque,
equal to the one who believes in Allah and the Last Day
segs.tr: KAMAN AAMANA BILLAAHE WAL YAWMIL AAKHERE

segs.ar: وَجَاهَدَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللهِ لَا يَسْتَوْنَ عِنْدَ
segs.en: and fights in the way of Allah, they are not equal near
segs.tr: WA JAAHADA FEE SABEELILLAAHE LAA YASTAWNA I’NDAL

segs.ar: اللهِ وَاللهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
segs.en: Allah and Allah does not guide the oppressive people.
segs.tr: LAAHE WALLAAHO LAA YAHDEEL QAWMAZ ZAALEMEENAL

segs.en: Those who believed and migrated and fought
segs.tr: LAZEENA A AAMANOO WA HAAJAROO WA JAAHADOO

segs.en: in the way of Allah with their wealth and lives,
segs.tr: FEE SABEELILLAAHE BE AMWAALEHIM WA ANFOSEHIM

segs.ar: اَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً عِنْدَ اللهِ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ
segs.en: they will have an esteemed status near Allah and they will be the
segs.tr: A-A’ZAMO DARAJATAN I’NDALLAAHE WA OOLAAA-EKA HOMUL

segs.en: successful ones. Their Lord gives them the glad tidings of mercy from Him
segs.tr: FAAA-EZOONA YOBASH SHEROHUM RABBOHUM BERAHMATIN MINHO

segs.en: and satisfaction and the gardens in which are everlasting bounties, abiding
segs.tr: WARIZWAANIN WA JANNAATIN FEEHA NA-E’EMUN MOQEEMUN

segs.ar: خَالِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا اَبَدًا اِنَّ اللهَ عِنْدَهٗ اَجْرٌ عَظِيْمٌ
segs.en: therein forever. Surely, near Allah is a great reward (for them).
segs.tr: KHAALEDEENA FEEHAA ABADAN INNAL LAAHA I’NDAHU AJRUN A’ZEEMUN

segs.en: I bear witness that you have been particularized for the Praise

segs.ar: اللهِ الْمُخْلِصُ لِطَاعَةِ اللهِ لَمْ تَبْغِ
segs.en: of Allah, the sincere one in the obedience of Allah, you did not desire anything in exchange
of guidance and did not associate anybody in the worship
segs.tr: BIL HODAA BADALAN WALAM TUSHRIK BE E’BAADATE

segs.ar: رَبِّكَ اَحَدًا وَاَنَّ اللهَ تَعَالَي اسْتَجَابَ
segs.en: of your Lord. And (I bear witness) that Allah, the High, answered
segs.tr: RABBEKA AHADAN WA ANNALLAAHA TA-A’ALAS TAJAABA

segs.ar: لِنَبِيِّهٖ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ فِيْكَ
segs.en: the prayer of His Prophet, blessings of Allah be upon him and his progeny, concerning you,
segs.tr: LENABEEYEHI SALLALLAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI FEEKA

segs.ar: دَعْوَتَهٗ ثُمَّ اَمَرَهٗ بِاِظْهَارِ مَا اَوْلَاكَ
segs.en: and then He ordered him to make public your mastership
segs.tr: DA’WATAHU SUMMA AMARAHU BE IZHAARE MAA AWLAAKA

segs.en: in his nation, as an elevation of your status and an announcement
segs.tr: LE UMMATEHI EA’LAAA-AN LE SHAANEKA WA EA’LAANAN

segs.en: for your proof and a demolition of falsehood
segs.tr: LE BURHAANEKA WA DAHZAN LILABAATEELE WAQAT-A’N

segs.en: and to cut out the made-up excuses. Then when he feared the mischief
of the transgressors and was apprehensive for you about the hypocrites,
the Lord of the Universe revealed unto him,

segs.ar: يَآ اَيُّهَا الرَّسُوْلُ بَلِّغْ مَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكَ
segs.en: "O Apostle! Convey what has come down to you from
segs.tr: YAA AYYOHARRASOOLO BALLIGH MAA UNZELA ELAYKA

segs.ar: مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَاِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ
segs.en: your Lord and if you do it not, then you have not conveyed
segs.tr: MIN RABBEKA WA IN LAM TAF-A’L FAMAA BALLAGHTA

segs.en: the message and Allah will protect you from the people.
Then he took upon him the burden of travelling
and in the daunting heat of noon,
then he delivered a sermon audible to the people, and conveyed the message to them.
segs.tr: FA KHATABA WA ASMA-A’ WA NAADAA FA ABLAGHA SUMMA

segs.en: Then he asked them all, Have I conveyed the message?
They replied, ‘Yes, by Allah! He then said, ‘O Allah!
You bear witness. Then he said, "Am I not having
more authority over the believers then they have on their ownselves?’ They replied, ‘Yes.’

segs.ar: فَاَخَذَ بِيَدِكَ وَقَالَ مَنْ كُنْتُ مَوْلَاهُ
segs.en: Then he held your hand and said, ‘Of whomsoever I am the Master,

segs.ar: فَهٰذَا عَلِيٌّ مَوْلَاهُ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَالِ مَنْ
segs.en: this Ali is his master. O Allah! You befriend
segs.tr: FAHAAZA ALIYUN MAULAAHO ALLAAHUMMA WAALE MAN

segs.ar: وَالَاهُ وَعَادِ مَنْ عَادَاهُ وَانْصُرْ مَنْ
segs.en: him who befriends Ali and You bear enmity with the one who bears enmity with Ali and You help him who
segs.tr: WALAAHO WA’’ade MAN AADAAHO WA ANSUR MAN

segs.ar: نَصَرَهٗ وَاخْذُلْ مَنْ خَذَلَهٗ فَمَا اٰمَنَ
segs.en: helps Ali and You forsake the one who forsakes Ali. Then none believed
segs.tr: NASRARAHU WA AKHZUL MAN KHAZALAHU FAMAA AMANA

segs.ar: بِمَا اَنْزَلَ اللهُ فِيْكَ عَلٰي نَبِيِّهٖ اِلَّا
segs.en: in what Allah sent down upon His Apostle
segs.tr: BEMA ANZALA LLAAHO FEEKA A’LAA NABEEYEHI ILLA

segs.ar: قَلِيْلٌ وَلَا زَادَ اَكْثَرَهُمْ غَيْرَ تَخْسِيْرٍ
segs.en: concerning you except a few and the majority of them gained nothing but loss
segs.tr: QALEELUN WALA ZAADA AKSARAHUM GHAIRA TAKHSEERIN

segs.ar: وَلَقَدْ اَنْزَلَ اللهُ تَعَالٰي فِيْكَ مِنْ
segs.en: while surely Allah has send down verses concerning

segs.ar: قَبْلُ وَهُمْ كَارِهُوْنَ يَآ اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ
segs.en: you previously while they were averse to it: "O you who
segs.tr: QABLOWA HUM KAAREHOONA YA AYYOHAL LAZEENA

segs.ar: اٰمَنُوْا مَنْ يَّرْتَدَّ مِنْكُمْ عَنْ دِيْنِهٖ
segs.en: believe! Whomsoever of you who turns away from his religion,
(he will not harm Allah in any way) for then surely Allah will bring forth a group whom He will love
segs.tr: FASAWFA YA YAATILLAAHO BE QAWMIN YOHIBBOHUM

segs.en: and they will love Him. They will be humble before the believers and very severe
segs.tr: WA YOHIBBOONAHU AZILLATIN A’LAL MOMINEENA A-I’ZZATIN

segs.en: upon the disbelievers. They will fight in the way of
Allah and will not fear the slandering of any slanderer (in the way of Allah).

segs.ar: ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللهِ يُؤْتِيْهِ مَنْ يَشَّآءُ
segs.en: That is the Grace of Allah, He grants it to whomsoever

segs.ar: وَاللهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيْمٌ اِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ اللهُ
segs.en: He wishes. And Allah is Abundant, All Knowing. Surely, your Guardian is Allah
and His Apostle and those who
establish prayer and offer poor-due
while they are bowing and whomsoever takes Allah
segs.tr: WA HUM RAAKEO’ONA WA MAN YATAWWALALLAAHA

segs.en: and His Apostle and those who believe as guardian, then surely the group of
segs.tr: WA RASOOLAHU WAL LAZEENA AAAMANU FA-INNA HIZBAL

segs.ar: اللهِ هُمُ الْغَالِبُوْنَ رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا بِمَا
segs.en: Allah will be successful. O Allah! We believe in what
segs.tr: LAAHE HOMUL GHAALEBOONA RABBANAA AAMANNA BEMAA

segs.en: You have revealed and we followed the Prophet, then include us among

segs.ar: الشَّاهِدِيْنَ رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ
segs.en: the witnesses. O Our Lord, do not deviate our hearts after You
segs.tr: SHAAHEDEENA RABBANAA LAA TOZIGH QOLOOBANA BA’DA

segs.ar: اِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ
segs.en: have guided us and grant us
segs.tr: IZ HADAYTANAA WAHAB LANAA MIN LADUNKA

segs.en: Mercy from Your side, Surely You are the Abundant Giver.

segs.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَعْلَمُ اَنَّ هٰذَا هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ
segs.en: O Allah, we know that this is the truth from
segs.tr: ALLAAHUMMA INNAA NA’LAMO ANNA HAAZAA HWAL HAQQO MIN

segs.en: Your side then curse those who oppose it and exhibit haughtiness concerning it
and reject it and disbelieve in it and soon
segs.tr: WA KAZZABA BEHI WA KAFARA WA SAYA’LAMUL LAZEENA

segs.en: the oppressors shall know where they will be transferred to.
Peace be on you, O the leader of the faithful
and the chief of the vicegerent and the first of the worshippers
segs.tr: WA SAYYEDAL WASEEYYEENA WA AWWALAL A’ABEDEENA

segs.en: and the most abstinent one and the Mercy of Allah
and His Blessings and His Salutations and His Greetings. You
segs.tr: WA BARAKAATOHU WA SALAWAATOHU WA TAHIYYAATOHU ANTA

segs.en: fed the disolates, the orphans

segs.ar: وَيَتِيْمًا وَاَسِيْرًا لِوَجْهِ اللهِ لَا تُرِيْدُ
segs.en: and the captive in the love of Allah, seeking His pleasure, you did
segs.tr: WA YATEEMAN WA ASEERAN LEWAJHILLAAHE LAA TOREEDO

segs.en: not desire from them any recompense or thanks and concerning you
segs.tr: MINHUM JAZAAA-AN WALAA SHOKOORAN WA FEEKA

segs.en: Allah, the Exalted has revealed, ‘And they give preference
to others over themselves even though their resources scarce.’
segs.tr: ANFOSEHIM WA LAW KAANA BEHIM KHASAASATUN

segs.ar: وَمَنْ يُّوْقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ
segs.en: And one who guards against the stinginess of his self, then these are
segs.tr: WA MAN YOOQA SHO-HA NAFSEHI FA AOOLAAA-EKA HOMUL

segs.en: the successful ones and you were having control over anger
and you were forgiving the people and Allah loves
segs.tr: WAL A’AFEE ANIN-NAASE WAL LAAHO YOHIBBUL

segs.en: those who do good (to others) and you were patient
in difficulties and troubles and misfortunes.
segs.tr: BAA-SAAA-E WAZ ZARRAAA-E WA HEENA L BAASE

segs.en: And you were equitable in distribution and just
segs.tr: WA ANTAL QAASEMO BIS SAWIYYATE WAL A’ADELO

segs.ar: فِيْ الرَّعِيَّةِ وَالْعَالِمُ بِحُدُوْدِ اللهِ مِنْ
segs.en: among the subjects and the most knowledgeable the limits imposed by Allah of
segs.tr: FIR RA-E’YYATE WAL A’ALEMO BE HODOODILLAAHE MIN

segs.ar: جَمِيْعِ الْبَرِيَّةِ وَاللهُ تَعَالٰي اَخْبَرَ عَمَّا
segs.en: all the people and Allah has informed one and all concerning the
segs.tr: JAMEE-I’L BARIYYATE WALLAAHO TA-A’ALAA AKHBARA A’MMAA

segs.ar: اَوْلَاكَ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ بِقَوْلِهٖ اَفَمَنْ كَانَ
segs.en: superiority He has granted you through His saying. Is the one who
segs.tr: AWLAAKA MIN FAZLEHI BE QAWLEHI AFAMAN KAANA

segs.ar: مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا يَسْتَوٗنَ
segs.en: is a believer akin to the one who is a transgressor. They are not equal.
segs.tr: MOMENAN KAMAN KAANA FAASEQAN LAA YASTA-OONA

segs.en: As for those who believe and do good,
then for them are the abodes of Paradise,
a recompense for what they have done and have been
segs.tr: NOZOLAN BEMA KAANO YA’LAMOONA WA ANTAL

segs.en: specialised for knowledge of revelation and the wisdom
segs.tr: MAKHSOOSO BE I’LMIT TANZEELE WA HUKMIT

segs.en: of interpretation and the explicit mention by the Apostle and for you
segs.tr: TAAWEELE WA NASSIR RASOOLE WA LAKAL

segs.en: are distinguished stations and renowned positions and
the celebrated days, the day
of Badr and the day of Ahzaab when the
segs.tr: BADRIN WA YAWMAL AHZAABE IZ ZAAGHATIL

segs.en: eyes had severed and the hearts rose
upto the throats and you started having opinions about Allah, there was the examination
segs.tr: WA TAZUNNOONA BILLAAHIZ ZONOONAA HONAALEKAB TOLEYAL

segs.en: of the believers and they were shaken with a vigorous shaking
when the hypocrites and those in
segs.tr: WA IZ YAQOOLUL MONAAFEQOONA WAL LAZEENA FEE

segs.en: whose hearts was sickness said: Allah and His Apostle have not promised us

segs.ar: وَرَسُوْلُهٗ اِلَّا غُرُوْرًا وَاِذْ قَالَتْ طَآئِفَةٌ
segs.en: anything except deception. When a group from among them said,
segs.tr: WA RASOOLOHU ILLAA GHOROORAN WA IZ QAALAT TAA-EFATUN

segs.ar: مِنْهُمْ يَآ اَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ
segs.en: ‘O the people of Medina! There is no play of stay for you here,
segs.tr: MINHUM YAA AHLA YASREBA LAA MOKAAMA LAKUM

segs.en: then return back, while a group of them

segs.ar: النَّبِيَّ يَقُوْلُوْنَ اِنَّ بُيُوْتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا
segs.en: were saying: Surely our houses are empty even though they were not,
segs.tr: NABEEYYA YAQOOLOONA INNA BOYOOTANAA A’WRATUN WAMAA

segs.ar: هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ اِنْ يُّرِيْدُوْنَ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
segs.en: they only desired to run away.
segs.tr: HEYA BE A’WRATIN IN YOREEDOONA ILLAA FERAARAN

segs.ar: وَقَالَ اللهُ تَعَالٰي وَلَمَّارَ اَي الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ
segs.en: And Allah, the High, said, ‘And when the believers
segs.tr: WA QAALALLAAHO TA-A’ALAA WALAMMAA RA-AL MOMENOONAL

segs.ar: الْاَحْزَابَ قَالُوْا هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللهُ
segs.en: saw the allies, they said. That is what Allah
segs.tr: AHZAABA QAALOO HAAZAA MAA WA A’DANALLAAHO

segs.en: and His Apostle had promised us and Allah and His Apostle
segs.tr: WA RASOOLOHU WA SADAQALLAAHO WA MAA

segs.en: have spoken the truth and their faith and submission
segs.tr: ZAADAHUM ILLA EEMANAN WA TASLEEMAN FAQATALAT

segs.en: was augmented on account of it, then you killed Amr and defeated their armies and Allah
segs.tr: A’MRAHUM WA HAZAMTA JAM-A’HUM WA RADDAL LAAHUL

segs.en: made the disbelievers return in anger, they did not reach to any
segs.tr: LAZEENA KAFAROO BE GHAIZEHIM LAM YANAALOO

segs.en: goodness and Allah is Sufficient for the believers

segs.ar: وَكَانَ اللهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيْزًا وَيَوْمَ اُحُدٍ اِذْ
segs.en: in fighting and Allah is Powerful, Honoured and on the Day of Ohad when
segs.tr: WA KAANALLAAHO QAWIYYAN AZEEZAN WA YAWMA OHADIN IZ

segs.en: the people climbed atop the mountains and did not turn back to look at anyone
even though the Apostle was calling them from behind and you were repelling the
scavengers from the polytheists away
segs.tr: WA ANTA TAZOODO BOHAMAL MUSHREKEENA A’NIN

segs.en: from the Prophet from the right and from the left
segs.tr: NABBIYYE ZAATAL YAMEENE WA ZAATAS SHEMAALE

segs.en: till the time Allah repelled them from you both
while they were in the state of fear and through you, He helped the forsaken ones and on the Day
segs.tr: KHAAA-EFEENA WA NASARA BEKAL KHAAZELEENA WA YAWMA

segs.ar: حُنَيْنٍ عَلٰي مَا نَطَقَ بِهِ التَّنْزِيْلُ اِذْ
segs.en: of Hunain as Quran says, ‘When the abundance of
segs.tr: HONAYNIN A’LAA MAA NATAQA BEHIT TANZEELO IZ

segs.en: your number amazed you but it did not benefit you
at all and the earth became straitened for you in spite of
segs.tr: SHAYAN WAZAA QAT ALAYKUMUL ARZO BEMAA

segs.ar: رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُمْ مُدْبِرِيْنَ ثُمَّ اَنْزَلَ
segs.en: its vastness, then you turned back, then
segs.tr: RAHOBAT SUMMA WALLAYTUM MUDBEREENA SUMMA ANZALAL

segs.en: Allah sent down tranquility upon His Apostle and the
segs.tr: LAAHO SAKEENATAHU A’LAA RASOOLEHI WA A’LAL

segs.en: believing men and the term believers refers to you and
those who were with you and your uncle Abbas kept
on calling out of the fleeing Muslims. O the people of

segs.ar: الْبَقَرَةِ يَا اَهْلِ بَيْعَةِ الشَّجَرَةِ حَتّٰي
segs.en: the chapter of the cow, O those who had pledged allegiance under the tree till
segs.tr: BAQARATE YAA AHLE BAYTISH SHAJARATE HATTAS

segs.ar: اسْتَجَابَ لَهٗ قَوْمٌ قَدْ كَفَيْتَهُمُ الْمَؤُنَةَ
segs.en: a group of them responded. Then you arranged for their provisions
segs.tr: TAJAABA LAHU QAWMUN QAD KAFAYTOHOMUL MA-OONATA

segs.en: and became their protector for their daily necessities.

segs.ar: اٰيِسِيْنَ مِنَ الْمَثُوْبَةِ رَاجِيْنَ وَعْدَ اللهِ
segs.en: Then these people returned, despair of recompense, expectant of the promise of Allah,

segs.ar: تَعَالٰي بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَذٰلِكَ قَوْلُ اللهِ جَلَّ
segs.en: the High, through repentance. And that is the saying of Allah, Honoured
segs.tr: TA-A’ALAA BITTAWBATE WA ZAALEKA QAWLULLAAHE JALLA

segs.ar: ذِكْرُهٗ ثُمَّ يَتُوْبُ اللهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ
segs.en: be His Remembrance. Then Allah turned (with Mercy)
segs.tr: ZIKRAHU SUMMA YATOOBULLAAHO MIN BA’DE ZAALEKA

segs.ar: عَلٰي مَنْ يَشَآءُ وَاَنْتَ حَآئِزٌ دَرَجَةَ
segs.en: after that to whomsoever He wished and you were firmly on the grades
segs.tr: A’LAA MAN YASHAAA-O WA ANTA HAA-EZUN DARAJATAS

segs.en: of patience and successful with a great recompense and on the Day

segs.ar: خَيْبَرَ اِذْ اَظْهَرَ اللهُ خَوَرَ الْمُنَافِقِيْنَ
segs.en: of Khaibar, when Allah exposed the slackness of the hypocrites
and cut off the roots of the disbelievers
and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe

segs.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوْا عَاهَدُوْا اللهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ
segs.en: and surely they had made a covenant from Allah from before
segs.tr: WA LAQAD KAANOO A’AHADULLAAHA MIN QABLO

segs.ar: لَا يُوَلُّوْنَ الْاَدْبَارَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللهِ
segs.en: that they will not turn their backs and surely the covenant of Allah
segs.tr: LAA YOWALLOONAL ADBAARA WA KAANA A’HADULLAHE

segs.en: will be questioned. O my master, you are the far-reaching
argument and the evident aim and the perfect bounty
and the evident proof. Then congratulations be to you,
segs.tr: SAABEGHATO WAL BURHAANUL MONEERO FA-HANEE-AN LAKA

segs.ar: بِمَا اٰتٰيكَ اللهُ مِنْ فَضْلٍ وَتَبًّا
segs.en: due to what Allah has granted you from the grace, and may it be away from your enemy,
segs.tr: BEMA AATAAKALLAAHO MIN FAZLIN WA TABBAN

segs.en: the ignorant, You participated in all the

segs.ar: النَّبِيِّ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ جَمِيْعَ
segs.en: battles alongwith the Holy Prophet, blessings of Allah be on him and his progeny
segs.tr: NABIYYE SALLALLAAHO ALAYHE WA AALEHI JAMEE-A’N

segs.en: you carried the flags while leading him and were fighting with the sword
in front of him. Then
segs.tr: AMAAMAHU WA TAZREBO BIS SAYFE QUDDAAMAHU SUMMA

segs.en: due to Your famed prudence and your foresight
in the affairs, he made you
segs.tr: OMOORE AMMARAKA FIL MAWAATENE WA LAM

segs.ar: يَكُنْ عَلَيْكَ اَمِيْرٌ وَكَمْ مِنْ اَمْرٍ
segs.en: the commander in various places and there was no commander over you and there were so many affairs
segs.tr: YAKUN A’LAYKA AMEERUN WAKAM MIN AMRIN

segs.ar: صَدَّكَ عَنْ اِمْضَآءِ عَزْمِكَ فِيْهِ التُّقٰي
segs.en: in which piety kept desisted you from its
segs.tr: SADDAKA A’N IMZAAA-E A’ZMEKA FEEHIT TOQAA

segs.ar: وَاتَّبَعَ غَيْرُكَ فِيْ مِثْلِهِ الْهَوٰي فَظَنَّ
segs.en: performance while others have followed their desires in committing.
segs.tr: WAT-TABA-A’ GHAYROKA FEE MISLEHIL HAWAA FAZANNAL

segs.en: Then the ignorant used to opine that you were helpless

segs.ar: انْتَهٰي ضَلَّ وَاللهِ الظَّآنُّ لِذٰلِكَ وَمَا
segs.en: in their performance. It is not like that rather, by Allah, the one who thinks so is
segs.tr: TAHAA ZALLA WALLAAHIZ ZAAANNO LEZAALEKA WA MAH

segs.en: indeed deviated in his opinion and he is not guided and certainly by your words,
segs.tr: TADAA WA LAQAD AWZAHTA MAAA ASHKALA

segs.en: you had removed the skepticism of the presumers

segs.ar: بِقَوْلِكَ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْكَ قَدْ يَرَي
segs.en: and the falsehood of the slanderers. Blessings of Allah be upon you, ‘Certainly the variable
segs.tr: BE QAWLEKA SALLALLAAHO A’LAYKA QAD YARAL

segs.en: and adaptable ones see the rise which
segs.tr: HUWWALUL QULLABO WAJHAL HEELATEH WA DOONAHAA

segs.ar: حَاجِزٌ مِنْ تَقْوَي اللهِ فَيَدْعُهَا رَاْيَ
segs.en: only fear of Allah can impede. Then they forsake it
intentionally and those who have no soft-corner or
segs.tr: A’YNE WA YANTAHEZO FURSATAHAA MAN LAA

segs.en: concern for religion, they seize this opportunity.’ Surely you have spoken the truth
and the deniers are in loss. And when the
segs.tr: WA KHASERAL MUBTELOONA WA IZ MAAKARAKAN

segs.en: covenant breakers plotted against you and said that we have come to perform the ‘umrah’, you told them.
I swear by your life, you do not intend to perform umrah,
segs.tr: LAHOMAA LA-A’MRO KOMAA MAA TOREEDAANIL U’MRATA

segs.en: rather your intention is that of deceit. Then you took the pledge of allegiance
from both of them and renewed the covenant with them, they strove and struggled
in acts of hypocrisy. Then when you appraised them of their actions,
they were negligent and returned and did not pay
segs.tr: AGHFALAA WA-A’ADAA WA MAN TAFA-A’A WA KAANA

segs.en: any heed and the end-result of their affair was ‘loss’.
Then the people of Damascus followed them and you took after

segs.ar: الْاِعْذَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَدِيْنُوْنَ دِيْنَ الْحَقِّ
segs.en: completing the argument, rose up to defend against them while they did not believe in the true religion
segs.tr: EA’ZAARE WAHUM LAA YADEENOONA DEENAL HAQQE

segs.en: and did not ponder on the Holy Quran. They were debased, foolish and
segs.tr: WA LAA YATADABBAROONAL QUR-AANA HAMAJUN RA-A’A-U’N

segs.en: deviated and did not believe in all that
segs.tr: ZAAALLOONA WA BILLAZEE UNZELA A’LAA MOHAMMADIN

segs.en: was revealed on Mohammad concerning you.

segs.ar: عَلَيْكَ نَاصِرُوْنَ وَقَدْ اَمَرَ اللهُ تَعَالٰي
segs.en: They assisted your enemies while Allah, the High,
segs.tr: A’LAYKA NAASEROONA WA QAD AMARALLAAHO TA-A’ALAA

segs.en: had ordered them to follow you and had called them to

segs.ar: نَصْرِكَ وَقَالَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ يَآ اَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ
segs.en: assist you and He, the Honoured, the Majestic, said: O those who believe!
segs.tr: NASREKA WAQAALAA A’ZZA WAJALLA YAA AYYOHAL LAZEENA

segs.en: Fear Allah and be with the
truthful ones.’ O my master! Through you the truth
has been manifested when the creatures had forsaken it and you have made evident
segs.tr: WA QAD NABAZHUL KHALQO WA AWZAHTAS

segs.en: the ‘tradition’ after it had been eradicated and effaced.
Then you initially fought in the way of establishing the truth
of the revelation of Holy Quran and later on you fought to establish the actualization
segs.tr: TANZEELE WA LAKA FAZEELATAHUL JEHAADE A’LAA

segs.en: of the interpretation and your enemy
was the enemy of Allah, denier of the Apostle of Allah, he was calling towards falsehood
and ordering for tyranny and ruling with usurpation
segs.tr: WA YAHKOMO JAAA-ERAN WA YATA-AMMARO GHAASEBAN

segs.en: and was calling his party towards the fire while Ammar was
segs.tr: WA YAD-O’O HIZBAHU ILAN NAARE WA A’MMAA RUN

segs.en: fighting on your side and was calling out between the rows of battlefield:
Hasten towards Paradise and when he was thirsty,
segs.tr: RAWAAHAR RAWAAHA ELAL JANNATE WA LAMMAS

segs.en: he was offered milk and drink, he glorified Allah and stated that the
segs.tr: TASQAA FASOQEYAL LABANO KABBARA WA QAALA

segs.ar: قَالَ لِيْ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ
segs.en: Apostle of Allah peace be upon him and his

segs.ar: وَاٰلِهٖ اٰخِرُ شَرَابِكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا ضَيَاحٌ
segs.en: progeny had told him: The last drink that you will have in this world
segs.tr: WA AALEHI WA AAKHERO SHARAABEKA MENAD DUNYAA ZAYAAHUN

segs.en: will be milk and the rebellious group will kill you.
segs.tr: MIN LABANIN WA TAQTOLOKAL FE-ATUL BAAGHEYATO

segs.en: Then Abul Aadiyaa al-Fazaari came forward and he killed Ammaar.

segs.ar: فَعَلٰي اَبِيْ الْعَادِيَةِ لَعْنَةُ اللهِ وَلَعْنَةُ
segs.en: Then upon Abul Aadiyah be the curse of Allah,
segs.tr: FA-A’LAA ABIL A’ADEYATE LA’NATULLAAHE WA LA’NATO

segs.en: His angles and His Apostles, all of them and also on
segs.tr: MALAAA-EKATEHI WA ROSOLEHI AJMA-E’ENA WA A’LAA

segs.en: those who raised their swords against you and you drew
segs.tr: MAN SALLA SAYFAHU A’LAYKA WA SALALTA

segs.ar: سَيْفَكَ عَلَيْهِ يَا اَمِيْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ مِنَ
segs.en: your sword against them, be they, O the commander of the faithful,
segs.tr: SAYFAKA A’LAYHE YAA AMEERAL MOMINEENA MENAL

segs.en: from the polytheists or the hypocrites, till the Day

segs.ar: الدِّيْنِ وَعَلٰي مَنْ رَضِيَ بِمَا سَآئَكَ
segs.en: of Judgement and those who were satisfied with the evil
segs.tr: DEENE WA A’LAA MAN RAZEYA BEMA SAAA-AKA

segs.en: that afflicted you and did not detest it, and covered it up and
segs.tr: WA LAM YAKRAH-HO WA AGHMAZA A’YNAHU WALAM

segs.ar: يُنْكِرْ اَوْ اَعَانَ عَلَيْكَ بِيَدٍ اَوْ لِسَانٍ
segs.en: did not deny it nor helped you to ward it off by their hand or tongue or sat down
segs.tr: YUNKIR AW A-A’ANA A’LAYKA BEYADIN AW LESAANIN

segs.ar: اَوْ قَعَدَ عَنْ نَصْرِكَ اَوْ خَذَلَ عَنِ
segs.en: when it came to helping you and forsook you in
segs.tr: AW QA-A’DAN A’N NASREKA AW KHAZALA A’NIL

segs.en: fighting and tried to reduce your superiority

segs.ar: وَجَحَدَ حَقَّكَ اَوْ عَدَلَ بِكَ مَنْ
segs.en: and denied your right or equated you with the one
segs.tr: WA JAHADA HAQQAKA AW A’DALA BEKA MAN

segs.ar: جَعَلَكَ اللهَ اَوْلٰي بِهٖ مِنْ نَفْسِهٖ
segs.en: over whom Allah has given you more authority than he has over himself.
Blessings of Allah be upon you, and the Mercy of Allah
and His Blessings and His Peace
and His Greetings and upon the leaders from the pure
segs.tr: WA TAHIYYAATOHU WA A’LAL A-IMMATE MIN AALEKAT

segs.en: progeny, surely He is the Praiseworthy, Majestic.
segs.tr: TAAHEREENA INNAHU HAMEEDUN MAJEEDUN WAL AMRUL

segs.en: And a most astonishing event and the most detestable situation after
the denial of your right was the usurpation of Fadak that belonged to the Truthful and Pure
and Fair lady (Fatimah), the leader of the women (of the universe)
and the rejection of your testimony and that
segs.tr: FADAKAN WA RADDO SHAHAADATEKA WA SHAHAADATIS

segs.en: of the two leaders from the progeny
of Al-Mustafa blessings of Allah be on you concerning

segs.ar: اَعْلَي اللهُ تَعَالٰي عَلَي الْاُمَّةِ دَرَجَتَكُمْ
segs.en: it while Allah has extolled your status over the nations and has raised your position
and has made clean your superiority and has
segs.tr: WA RAFA-A’ MANZELATAKUM WA ABAANA FAZLAKUM

segs.en: honoured you over the universe,
then He removed from you all types of filth and has purified you as purification ought to be,

segs.ar: قَالَ اللهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ
segs.en: Allah, the Honoured, the Majestic. Surely, man has been created greedy (by nature) and
segs.tr: QAALALLAAHO AZZA WA JALLA INNAL INSAANA KHOLEQA

segs.ar: هَلُوْعًا اِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوْعًا وَاِذَا
segs.en: when evil afflicts him, he becomes anxious and
segs.tr: HALOO-A’N EZAA MASSAHUSH SHARRO JAZOO-A’N WA EZAA

segs.en: when good occurs to him, he does not acknowledge except the praying ones.
Then Allah, the High, excepted His Prophet al-Mustafa

segs.ar: وَاَنْتَ يَا سَيِّدَ الْاَوْصِيَآءِ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ
segs.en: and you, O the chief of the vicegerents, from the entire creation.
segs.tr: WA ANTA YAA SAYYEDAL AWSEYAAA-E MIN JAMEE-I’L

segs.ar: الْخَلْقِ فَمَا اَعْمَهَ مَنْ ظَلَمَكَ عَنِ
segs.en: How blinded is he, who has oppressed you concerning your right, then through deceit
segs.tr: KHALQE FAMAA A’AMAHA MAN ZALAMAKA A’NIL

segs.en: they took away the share of the near ones of the Apostle and through oppression,
they prevented it from reaching to its rightful owners.
segs.tr: QURBAA MAKRAN WA AHAADOOHO A’N AHLEHI

segs.ar: جَوْرًا فَلَمَّا اٰلَ الْاَمْرُ اِلَيْكَ اَجْرَيْتَهُمْ
segs.en: Then, when the affair (of Caliphate) came to you, you left them
segs.tr: JAWRAN FALAMMAA AALAL AMRO ELAYKA AJRAYTAHUM

segs.ar: عَلٰي مَا اَجْرَ يَا رَغْبَةً عَنْهُمَا بِمَا عِنْدَ
segs.en: on their own and kept away from them, seeking reward from
segs.tr: A’LAA MAA AJRAYAA RAGHBATAN A’NHOMAA BEMAA I’NDAL

segs.en: Allah. How similar is your trial to those of the
Prophets, peace be upon them, in being
left alone and devoid of any helpers.
You were similar to the sacrificed ‘Ismaeel’ when you slept

segs.ar: عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ اِذَا اَجَبْتَ كَمَا اَجَابَ
segs.en: on the bed of the Apostle in the night of migration because you responded in
segs.tr: A’LAYHIS SALAAMO EZAA AJABTA KAMAA AJAABA

segs.en: the same manner as him and you obeyed that just as Ismael obeyed, being patient
segs.tr: WA ATA’TA KAMAA ATAA-A’ ISMAAE’ELO SAABERAN

segs.ar: مُحْتَسِبًا اِذْ قَالَ لَهٗ يَا بُنَيَّ اِنِّيْٓ اَرٰي
segs.en: and forebearing. When Ibrahim said to him, ‘O my son! Surely, I see
segs.tr: MOHTASEBAN IZ QAALA LAHU YA BONAYYA INNI ARAA

segs.ar: فِي الْمَنَامِ اَنِّيْ اَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا
segs.en: in the dream that I am slaughtering you, then what
segs.tr: FIL MANAAME ANNI AZBAHOKA FANZUR MAAZA

segs.ar: تَريٰ قَالَ يَا اَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ
segs.en: do you say? He said, ‘O father! You carry out what you have been ordered.
segs.tr: TARAA QAALA YAA ABATIF-A’L MAA TOAMARO

segs.en: You will soon find me among the patient ones

segs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنْتَ لَمَّا اَبَاتَكَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّي
segs.en: and you also recited in the same manner when the Prophet (blessings be
segs.tr: WA KAZAALEKA ANTA LAMMA ABAATAKAN NABIYYO SALLAL

segs.ar: اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاٰلِهٖ وَاَمَرَكَ اَنْ تَضْجِعَ
segs.en: upon him and his progeny) ordered you to spend the
segs.tr: LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI WA AMARAKA AN TAZJE-A’

segs.en: night sleeping in his bed in order that his life be saved.
segs.tr: FEE MARQADEHI WAAQEYAN LAHU BE NAFSEKA

segs.en: Then you responded very quickly and prepared
yourself to die obediently.
segs.tr: WA LE NAFSEKA A’LAL QATLO MAWATTENAN FA-SHAKARAL

segs.ar: اللهُ تَعَالٰي طَاعَتَكَ وَاَبَانَ عَنْ جَمِيْلِ
segs.en: Then Allah thanked your obedience and manifested your good
segs.tr: LAAHO TA-A’ALAA TAA-A’TAKA WA ABAANA A’N JAMEELE

segs.ar: فِعْلِكَ بِقَوْلِهٖ جَلَّ ذِكْرُهٗ وَمِنَ النَّاسِ
segs.en: deed through His saying, ‘And from among the men are those
segs.tr: FE’LAKA BE QAWLEHI JALLA ZIKROHU WA MENAN NAASE

segs.en: who sell their souls to seek the satisfaction of Allah.

segs.ar: اللهِ ثُمَّ مِحْنَتُكَ يَوْمَ صِفِّيْنَ وَقَدْ
segs.en: And then your examination of the Day of Siffeen when
segs.tr: LLAHE SUMMA MEHNATOKA YAWMA SIFFEENA WA QAD

segs.en: people raised the Holy Quran in deceit, the people
became skeptical and truth was covered,
and conjectures were followed.This resembled the examination of Haroon
segs.tr: WAT TOBE-A’Z ZANNO ASHBAHAT MEHNATA HAAROONA

segs.ar: اِذْ اَمَّرَهٗ مُوْسٰي عَلٰي قَوْمِهٖ فَتَفَرَّقُوْا
segs.en: when Moosa made them the leader of his nation then they separated
segs.tr: IZ AMMARAHU MOOSA A’LAA QAWMEHI FATAFARRAQOO

segs.en: from him while Haroon was calling to them saying,
segs.tr: A’NHO WA HAAROONO YONAADEE BEHIM WA YAQOOLO

segs.ar: يَا قَوْمٍ اِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهٖ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ
segs.en: ‘O my people, surely you are being examined through this and surely your Lord
segs.tr: YAA QAWME INNAMAA FOTINTUM BEHI WA INNA RABBAKOMUR

segs.en: is the All-Beneficent, then you follow me and obey my command.’

segs.ar: قَالُوْا لَنْ نَبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفِيْنَ حَتّٰي
segs.en: They replied, ‘We will keep on worshipping the calf till
segs.tr: QAALOO LAN NABRAHA A’LAYHE A’AKEFEENA HATTA

segs.en: the time Moosa returns. The same things occurred with you. When the Holy Quran
segs.tr: YARJE-A’ ELAYNA MOOSAA WA KAZAALEKA ANTA

segs.ar: لَمَّا رُفِعَتِ الْمَصَاحِفُ قُلْتَ يَا قَوْمِ
segs.en: were being raised, you called out, O my people,
segs.tr: LAMMA ROFE-A’TIL MASAAHEFO QULTA YAA QAWME

segs.en: you are being examined by it and you are being deceived,
segs.tr: INNAMA FOTINTUM BEHAA WA KHO-DEA’TUM FA A’SAWKA

segs.en: then they disobeyed you and opposed you and called for arbitration
so you refused and disowned from them
segs.tr: HAKAMAYNE FA ABAYTA A’LAYHIM WA TABARRAATA

segs.ar: اِلَي اللهِ مِنْ فِعْلِهِمْ وَفَوَّضْتَهٗ اِلَيْهِمْ
segs.en: infront of Allah and you left the matter to them.
segs.tr: ELALLAAHE MIN FEA’LEHIM WA FAWWAZTAHU ELAYHIM

segs.en: Then when the truth was made evident and
segs.tr: FALAMMA ASFARAL HAQQO WA SAFEHAL MUNKARO

segs.en: the foolishness was exposed and they admitted to their mistakes and tyranny and opposed
oppression after that and made allegations that you had
segs.tr: QASDIKH TALAFOO MIN BA’DEHI WA ALZAMOOKA

segs.en: set up the foolish act of arbitration which in fact you had opposed and they wanted it.
You warned them about it but they deemed their sin as permissible.
segs.tr: WA AHABBOOHU WA KHATARATAHU WA ABAAHOWAA ZANBAHOMUL

segs.en: While you were on the peak of foresight
segs.tr: LAZIQ TARAFOOHO WA ANTA A’LAA NAHJE

segs.en: and guidance and they were on the path of
segs.tr: BASEERAT IN WAHODAN WAHUM A’LAA SONANIN

segs.en: deviation and blindness. They then persisted in their
segs.tr: ZALAALATIN WA A’MAN FAMAA ZAALOO A’LAN

segs.en: hypocrisy and wandering back and forth in error,
until Allah made them taste the evil consequences of their affair;
then He caused the one who opposed you to die by your sword, so he became wretched
segs.tr: FA AMAATA BESAYFEKA MAN A’ANADAKA FA SHAQEYA
